## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(writexl)
library(janitor)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r define-output-directories}

output_directory <- "results"

results_directory <- output_directory

tables_directory <- file.path(
  output_directory,
  "tables"
)

```{r notebook-audit, eval=FALSE}
rmd_lines <- readLines("WORKING NOTEBOOK.Rmd", warn = FALSE)

# 1. Find all R chunk labels
chunk_lines <- grep("^```\\{r", rmd_lines)
chunk_text <- rmd_lines[chunk_lines]

chunk_labels <- sub("^```\\{r\\s*", "", chunk_text)
chunk_labels <- sub(",.*$", "", chunk_labels)
chunk_labels <- sub("\\}.*$", "", chunk_labels)
chunk_labels <- trimws(chunk_labels)

chunk_audit <- data.frame(
  line = chunk_lines,
  chunk_label = chunk_labels
)

# 2. Find duplicate chunk labels
duplicate_chunks <- chunk_audit[
  duplicated(chunk_audit$chunk_label) |
    duplicated(chunk_audit$chunk_label, fromLast = TRUE),
]

duplicate_chunks

# 3. Find plain ```r fences
plain_r_fences <- grep("^```r\\s*$", rmd_lines)

plain_r_fence_audit <- data.frame(
  line = plain_r_fences,
  text = rmd_lines[plain_r_fences]
)

plain_r_fence_audit

# 4. Find all output_directory definitions
output_directory_lines <- grep("output_directory\\s*<-", rmd_lines)

output_directory_audit <- data.frame(
  line = output_directory_lines,
  text = rmd_lines[output_directory_lines]
)

output_directory_audit

# 5. Find performance-summary object names
performance_lines <- grep(
  "tool_performance_summary|binary_tool_performance_summary",
  rmd_lines
)

performance_audit <- data.frame(
  line = performance_lines,
  text = rmd_lines[performance_lines]
)

performance_audit

# 6. Find tool-category map definitions
category_map_lines <- grep(
  "tool_category_map\\s*<-|binary_tool_category_map\\s*<-",
  rmd_lines
)

category_map_audit <- data.frame(
  line = category_map_lines,
  text = rmd_lines[category_map_lines]
)

category_map_audit
```

# Descriptive Analysis

## Pathogenicity distribution
This analysis summarises the nuber and percentage of variants in each observed pathogenicity category, helping to determine if the dataset is balanced across the various pathogenicity categories

```{r pathogenicity-summary}
pathogenicity_table <- table(DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Observed_pathogenicity)

pathogenicity_summary <- data.frame(
  Observed_pathogenicity = names(pathogenicity_table),
  n = as.integer(pathogenicity_table)
)

pathogenicity_summary$percentage <- round(
  pathogenicity_summary$n / sum(pathogenicity_summary$n) * 100,
  1
)

pathogenicity_summary
```

```{r pathogenicity-plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
pathogenicity_plot <- ggplot(
  pathogenicity_summary,
  aes(x = Observed_pathogenicity, y = n, fill = Observed_pathogenicity)
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of variants by pathogenicity classification",
    x = "Observed pathogenicity",
    y = "Number of variants",
    fill = "Pathogenicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

pathogenicity_plot
```
The results indicate that the dayaset contains a higher nuber of P/LP compared to the B/LB variants. it also showed that the dataset contained a large number of VUS which highlights the need for computational prediction tools in variant interpretation

## Variant effect distribution
This analysis examines the funtional consequences of variants in the dataset, showing how the the various different variant effect categories such as misssense,promoter,frameshift,spliceregion and UTR variants are ditributed across the observed pathogenicity classes

```{r effect-summary}
effect_summary <- as.data.frame(
  table(
    DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Effect_function,
    DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Observed_pathogenicity
  )
)

colnames(effect_summary) <- c(
  "Effect_function",
  "Observed_pathogenicity",
  "n"
)

effect_summary <- effect_summary[effect_summary$n > 0, ]

effect_summary$percentage_within_effect <- ave(
  effect_summary$n,
  effect_summary$Effect_function,
  FUN = function(x) round(x / sum(x) * 100, 1)
)

effect_summary <- effect_summary[
  order(effect_summary$n, decreasing = TRUE),
]

effect_summary
```

```{r effect-plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
effect_plot <- ggplot(
  effect_summary,
  aes(x = reorder(Effect_function, n), y = n, fill = Observed_pathogenicity)
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Variant effect distribution by pathogenicity",
    x = "Variant effect",
    y = "Number of variants",
    fill = "Pathogenicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

effect_plot
```

the distribution identified that missense variants were the most abundant in the dataset

## Missense versus non-missense variants
This focuses on the grouping of variants into missense and non missense categories in order to determine the quantity of the dataset relevant for in silico prediction

```{r variant-group-summary}
DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$variant_group <- ifelse(
  grepl("missense", DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Effect_function, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Missense",
  "Non-missense"
)

variant_group_summary <- as.data.frame(
  table(
    DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$variant_group,
    DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Observed_pathogenicity
  )
)

colnames(variant_group_summary) <- c(
  "variant_group",
  "Observed_pathogenicity",
  "n"
)

variant_group_summary <- variant_group_summary[variant_group_summary$n > 0, ]

variant_group_summary$percentage <- ave(
  variant_group_summary$n,
  variant_group_summary$variant_group,
  FUN = function(x) round(x / sum(x) * 100, 1)
)

variant_group_summary
```

```{r variant-group-plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
variant_group_plot <- ggplot(
  variant_group_summary,
  aes(x = variant_group, y = n, fill = Observed_pathogenicity)
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Missense versus non-missense variants by pathogenicity",
    x = "Variant group",
    y = "Number of variants",
    fill = "Pathogenicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

variant_group_plot
```

The results indicate that missense variants make up a majority of VUS supporting its relevance in tools evaluation

## VUS distribution
This analysis focuses only on variants classified as VUS  to identify which variant effect categories contribute most to uncertainty in the dataset

```{r vus-summary}

  DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Observed_pathogenicity == "VUS",
]

vus_summary <- as.data.frame(
  table(
    vus_data$HGVS,

  )
)

colnames(vus_summary) <- c(

  "Effect_function",
  "n"
)

vus_summary <- vus_summary[vus_summary$n > 0, ]

vus_summary <- vus_summary[
  order(vus_summary$n, decreasing = TRUE),
]

vus_summary
```

```{r vus-effect-summary}

```{r vus-effect-plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

```{r classified-plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}

As P/LP was in greateR quantities than B/LB,it is necessary for this imbalance to be considered during later performance analysis as metrics such as accuracy may be affected when one class is larger than the other.

## Missingness analysis of prediction tools
It analyses how much prediction score data is available for each tool for fair comparison of the tools

```{r tool-columns}
tool_cols <- c(
  "SIFT_score",
  "integrated_fitCons_score",
  "MutationTaster_score",
  "LRT_score",
  "PolyPhen_score",
  "SpliceAI_DS",
  "ClinPred_score",
  "DANN_score",
  "LIST-S2_score_seperated",
  "MetaSVM_score",
  "MutPred_score",
  "REVEL_score",
  "VEST4_score_seperated",
  "fathmm-MKL_coding_score",
  "ada_score",
  "rf_score",
  "Condel_score",
  "MetaLR_score",
  "GERP++_RS",
  "Eigen-PC-phred_coding",
  "BayesDel_addAF_score",
  "FATHMM_score_seperated",
  "MutationAssessor_standalone_score",
  "PROVEAN_score_seperated",
  "CADD_PHRED",
  "phyloP100way_vertebrate",
  "phyloP30way_mammalian",
  "phastCons30way_mammalian",
  "phastCons17way_primate",
  "SiPhy_29way_logOdds",
  "Eigen-phred_coding",
  "MaxEntScan_diff",
  "MaxEntScan_score"
)

tool_cols <- tool_cols[tool_cols %in% names(DATASET_FOR_PROJECT)]

tool_cols
```

```{r missingness-summary}
missing_counts <- sapply(
  DATASET_FOR_PROJECT[tool_cols],
  function(x) sum(is.na(x))
)

available_counts <- sapply(
  DATASET_FOR_PROJECT[tool_cols],
  function(x) sum(!is.na(x))
)

missingness_summary <- data.frame(
  tool = names(missing_counts),
  missing_n = as.integer(missing_counts),
  available_n = as.integer(available_counts),
  missing_percentage = round(missing_counts / nrow(DATASET_FOR_PROJECT) * 100, 1),
  available_percentage = round(available_counts / nrow(DATASET_FOR_PROJECT) * 100, 1)
)

missingness_summary <- missingness_summary[
  order(missingness_summary$missing_percentage, decreasing = TRUE),
]

missingness_summary
```

```{r missingness-plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
missingness_plot <- ggplot(
  missingness_summary,
  aes(x = reorder(tool, missing_percentage), y = missing_percentage)
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Missing prediction scores across in silico tools",
    x = "Prediction tool",
    y = "Missing scores (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

missingness_plot
```


## Heatmap of mean tool scores by pathogenicity class
It summarises the average prediction scores of selected tools across pathogenicty classes in order to visualise whther prediction scores differ between B/LB. P/LP and VUS

```{r heatmap-mean-scores, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
tool_means <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = 3,
  ncol = length(tool_cols)
)

rownames(tool_means) <- c("P/LP", "B/LB", "VUS")
colnames(tool_means) <- tool_cols

for (i in seq_along(tool_cols)) {
  col_name <- tool_cols[i]
  values <- as.numeric(as.character(DATASET_FOR_PROJECT[[col_name]]))
  
  tool_means["P/LP", i] <- mean(
    values[DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Observed_pathogenicity == "P/LP"],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  tool_means["B/LB", i] <- mean(
    values[DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Observed_pathogenicity == "B/LB"],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  tool_means["VUS", i] <- mean(
    values[DATASET_FOR_PROJECT$Observed_pathogenicity == "VUS"],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

pheatmap(
  tool_means,
  scale = "column",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  main = "Mean in silico tool scores by pathogenicity class"
)
```

```{r import-new-ensembl-vep-output, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT <- readr::read_csv(
  "C:/Users/HP/Documents/ASSESSMENT OF IN SILICO TOOLS FOR VARIANT EFFECT PREDICTION IN HAEMOGLOBINOPATHIES/haemoglobinopathy-variant/ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  trim_ws = TRUE
)

dim(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)

names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)

```

```{r create-vep-input-identifier}

# Inspect likely variant identifier columns
possible_vep_id_columns <- grep(
  "uploaded|variation|vep",
  names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

possible_vep_id_columns

# Standardise the uploaded variant identifier to vep_input
if ("vep_input" %in% names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)) {

  message(
    "Column already named vep_input; no renaming required."
  )

} else if ("Uploaded_variation" %in% names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)) {

  ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT <- ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT %>%
    rename(
      vep_input = Uploaded_variation
    )

} else if ("#Uploaded_variation" %in% names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)) {

  ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT <- ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT %>%
    rename(
      vep_input = `#Uploaded_variation`)} else {

  stop(
    paste(
      "Could not find the VEP uploaded-variant identifier.",
      "Available candidate columns:",
      paste(possible_vep_id_columns, collapse = ", ")))}

# Confirm successful creation
"vep_input" %in%
  names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)

```

```{r clean-vep-input-identifier}

ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT <- ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT %>%
  mutate(
    vep_input = trimws(
      as.character(vep_input)
    )
  )

```

##inspection of the dataset to ensure that it was imported correctly
```{r check-new-ensembl-vep-import}

dim(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)

head(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT, 5)

```


##standardise the columns in order to reduce the chances of errors and make merging easier and seamless

```{r standardise-vep-column-names}

# Remove a leading # from VEP column names
names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT) <- sub(
  "^#",
  "",
  names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)
)

# Convert spaces and punctuation to underscores
names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT) <- gsub(
  "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+",
  "_",
  names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)
)

# Remove leading or trailing underscores
names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT) <- gsub(
  "^_|_$",
  "",
  names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)
)

# Inspect cleaned column names
names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)

```


## this is to determine the overlap between original ddataset and the output from ver, checking how many unique variants from the original dataset are present in the new VEP output including the total datset rows number of unique GHCh38 variants, the number found in vep and number not found and the percentage found
```{r check-vep-overlap}

variant_overlap <- DATASET_FOR_PROJECT %>%
  summarise(
    
    total_rows = n(),
    
    unique_original_variants = n_distinct(
      .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    variants_found_in_vep = n_distinct(
      .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]][
        !is.na(.data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]]) &
        .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]] %in%
          ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT$vep_input
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    variants_not_found_in_vep = n_distinct(
      .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]][
        !is.na(.data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]]) &
        !.data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]] %in%
          ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT$vep_input
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    percent_found_in_vep = round(
      variants_found_in_vep /
        unique_original_variants * 100,
      1
    )
  )

variant_overlap
```
    
## identification the variants not found in VEP

unmatched_variants <- DATASET_FOR_PROJECT %>%

## determining the number of variants which have multiple rows and their percentages 
```{r vep-duplicate-summary}

vep_duplicate_summary <- tibble(
  
  total_unique_variants = nrow(
    vep_duplicate_check
  ),
  
  variants_with_multiple_rows = sum(
    vep_duplicate_check$n_vep_rows > 1
  ),
  
  variants_with_single_row = sum(
    vep_duplicate_check$n_vep_rows == 1
  ),
  
  percentage_with_multiple_rows = round(
    mean(
      vep_duplicate_check$n_vep_rows > 1

  ignore.case = TRUE)

```

```{r create-vep-input-column}

candidate_vep_id <- grep(
  "uploaded.*variation|variation.*uploaded",
  names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if ("vep_input" %in% names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)) {

  message("vep_input already exists; no renaming required.")

} else if (length(candidate_vep_id) == 1) {

  names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT)[
    names(ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT) == candidate_vep_id
  ] <- "vep_input"

} else {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Could not uniquely identify the uploaded VEP variant column. ",
      "Candidates found: ",
      paste(candidate_vep_id, collapse = ", ")) )}
```

## Assessment of variant overlap between datasets

Before merging, the overlap between the original GRCh38 variant identifiers and the Ensembl VEP output was assessed. This step determines how many unique original variants were successfully represented in the updated VEP output.
```{r assess-variant-overlap}

variant_overlap <- DATASET_FOR_PROJECT %>%
  summarise(
    
    total_rows = n(),
    
    unique_original_variants = n_distinct(
      .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    variants_found_in_vep = n_distinct(
      .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]][
        .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]] %in%
          ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT$vep_input
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    variants_not_found_in_vep = n_distinct(
      .data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]][
        !.data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]] %in%
          ENSEMBL_VEP_OUTPUT$vep_input
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    percent_found_in_vep = round(
      variants_found_in_vep /
        unique_original_variants * 100,
      1
    )
  )

variant_overlap

```
This summary provides an initial quality-control measure by quantifying the proportion of original GRCh38 variants represented in the updated VEP output.

## defining what counts as a usuable tool in order to determine real available outputs according to pathogenicty classifcation
```{r define-usable-tool-output-function}
is_usable_tool_value <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- trimws(as.character(x))
  
  !is.na(x) &
    x_clean != "" &
    x_clean != "-" &
    x_clean != "." &
    !(tolower(x_clean) %in% c("na", "nan", "null", "not_available", "not available"))
}
```

###Defining tool coverage function counting the number of variants with at least one usuable output for each tool

```{r define-tool-coverage-function}
count_tool_coverage <- function(data, tool_name, columns) {
  
  existing_columns <- columns[columns %in% names(data)]
  missing_columns <- columns[!columns %in% names(data)]
  
  total_variants <- if ("original_row_id" %in% names(data)) {
    dplyr::n_distinct(data$original_row_id)
  } else {
    nrow(data) }
  
  if (length(existing_columns) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        tool = tool_name,
        columns_present = NA_character_,
        missing_columns = paste(missing_columns, collapse = ";"),
        total_variants = total_variants,
        variants_with_tool_output = 0,
        variants_without_tool_output = total_variants,
        percent_with_tool_output = 0))}
  
  usable_matrix <- sapply(
    existing_columns,
    function(col) {
      is_usable_tool_value(data[[col]])} )
  
  if (is.vector(usable_matrix)) {
    usable_any <- usable_matrix
  } else {
    usable_any <- rowSums(usable_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) > 0}
  
  variants_with_output <- if ("original_row_id" %in% names(data)) {
    dplyr::n_distinct(data$original_row_id[usable_any])
  } else {
    sum(usable_any)}
  
  tibble(
    tool = tool_name,
    columns_present = paste(existing_columns, collapse = "; "),
    missing_columns = paste(missing_columns, collapse = "; "),
    total_variants = total_variants,
    variants_with_tool_output = variants_with_output,
    variants_without_tool_output = total_variants - variants_with_output,
    percent_with_tool_output = round(
      variants_with_output / total_variants * 100,
      1))}
```

## generate the coverage table
```{r generate-tool-coverage-table}
tool_coverage_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(tool_column_map),
    function(tool_name) {
      count_tool_coverage(
        data = ANALYSIS_DATASET,
        tool_name = tool_name,
        columns = tool_column_map[[tool_name]])})) %>%
  arrange(desc(variants_with_tool_output))

tool_coverage_summary
```

## clean up tool table
```{r create-clean-tool-coverage-table}
tool_coverage_results_table <- tool_coverage_summary %>%
  select(
    tool,
    total_variants,
    variants_with_tool_output,
    variants_without_tool_output,
    percent_with_tool_output
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_with_tool_output))

tool_coverage_results_table
```

exists("tool_coverage_results_table")

dim(tool_coverage_results_table)

## adding categories to tool coverage table

```{r add-categories-to-tool-coverage}
tool_coverage_by_category <- tool_coverage_results_table %>%
  left_join(
    tool_category_map,
    by = "tool"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tool_category = ifelse(
      is.na(tool_category),
      "Uncategorised",
      tool_category
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    tool_category,
    tool,
    total_variants,
    variants_with_tool_output,
    variants_without_tool_output,
    percent_with_tool_output
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    tool_category,
    desc(percent_with_tool_output)
  )

tool_coverage_by_category
```
## determinig if any tool was not classified
```{r check-uncategorised-tools}
uncategorised_tools <- tool_coverage_by_category %>%
  filter(tool_category == "Uncategorised")

uncategorised_tools
```

```{r summarise-tool-coverage-by-category}
category_coverage_summary <- tool_coverage_by_category %>%
  group_by(tool_category) %>%
  summarise(
    number_of_tools = n(),
    mean_coverage_percent = round(
      mean(percent_with_tool_output, na.rm = TRUE),
      1
    ),
    median_coverage_percent = round(
      median(percent_with_tool_output, na.rm = TRUE),
      1
    ),
    highest_tool_coverage = max(
      percent_with_tool_output,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    lowest_tool_coverage = min(
      percent_with_tool_output,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_coverage_percent))

category_coverage_summary
```

## plottimg coverage according to category

```{r plot-tool-coverage-by-category, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
tool_coverage_by_category_plot <- tool_coverage_by_category %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_group = case_when(
      percent_with_tool_output >= 80 ~ "High coverage",
      percent_with_tool_output >= 50 ~ "Moderate coverage",
      percent_with_tool_output > 0 ~ "Low coverage",
      TRUE ~ "No output"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(tool, percent_with_tool_output),
      y = percent_with_tool_output,
      fill = coverage_group
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ tool_category,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Coverage of in silico tool outputs by tool category",
    subtitle = "Percentage of variants with usable output for each tool",
    x = "Tool",
    y = "Variants with usable output (%)",
    fill = "Coverage level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

tool_coverage_by_category_plot
```

## Classification of tools for downstream analysis
the aim of this is to divide tools into various categories 

```{r define-downstream-analysis-groups}
tool_analysis_group_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~tool, ~analysis_group, ~reason,

  "SIFT", "Binary performance analysis", "Has established tolerated/deleterious threshold",
  "PolyPhen-2", "Binary performance analysis", "Has benign/possibly damaging/probably damaging interpretation",
  "MutationTaster", "Binary performance analysis", "Has categorical prediction labels",
  "LRT", "Binary performance analysis", "Has deleterious/neutral prediction interpretation",
  "MutationAssessor", "Binary performance analysis", "Has functional impact categories or score thresholds",
  "PROVEAN", "Binary performance analysis", "Has established deleterious/neutral threshold",
  "FATHMM", "Binary performance analysis", "Has established damaging/tolerated threshold",
  "FATHMM-MKL", "Binary performance analysis", "Has deleterious/neutral threshold",
  "VEST4", "Continuous score analysis", "No universal benign/pathogenic cutoff used here",

  "REVEL", "Binary performance analysis", "Commonly used threshold available",
  "ClinPred", "Binary performance analysis", "Has pathogenic/benign threshold",
  "MetaSVM", "Binary performance analysis", "Has tolerated/damaging threshold",
  "MetaLR", "Binary performance analysis", "Has tolerated/damaging threshold",
  "BayesDel addAF", "Binary performance analysis", "Has published threshold",
  "BayesDel noAF", "Binary performance analysis", "Has published threshold",
  "LIST-S2", "Binary performance analysis", "Has tolerated/deleterious threshold",
  "Condel", "Binary performance analysis", "Can use prediction label if available",

  "AlphaMissense", "Binary performance analysis", "Has likely benign, ambiguous and likely pathogenic classes",
  "EVE", "Binary performance analysis", "Can use EVE class labels",
  "popEVE", "Binary performance analysis", "Can use prediction labels if available",
  "ESM1b", "Continuous score analysis", "Threshold/direction depends on annotation source; use cautiously",
  "DEOGEN2", "Binary performance analysis", "Has prediction label or threshold",
  "MetaRNN", "Binary performance analysis", "Has prediction label",
  "MutPred / MutPred2", "Binary performance analysis", "Has score/prediction label; mainly missense-focused",
  "PrimateAI", "Binary performance analysis", "Has prediction label or threshold",
  "FATHMM-XF", "Binary performance analysis", "Has prediction label",

  "SpliceAI", "Splicing-specific analysis", "Predicts splice-altering potential",
  "ada_score", "Splicing-specific analysis", "Splicing predictor",
  "rf_score", "Splicing-specific analysis", "Splicing predictor",
  "MaxEntScan", "Splicing-specific analysis", "Splice-site strength/change score",

  "CADD", "Continuous score analysis", "Prioritisation/deleteriousness score; no universal diagnostic cutoff",
  "DANN", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous deleteriousness score without universal clinical cutoff",
  "MPC", "Continuous score analysis", "Missense constraint score, not direct binary classifier",
  "MVP", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal binary threshold used here",
  "MutFormer", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal threshold used here",
  "PHACTboost", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal threshold used here",
  "VARITY-R", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal threshold used here",
  "VARITY-ER", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal threshold used here",
  "VARITY-R-LOO", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal threshold used here",
  "VARITY-ER-LOO", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal threshold used here",
  "gMVP", "Continuous score analysis", "Continuous score; no universal threshold used here",
  "MisFit-D", "Continuous score analysis", "Fitness/constraint-style score",
  "MisFit-S", "Continuous score analysis", "Fitness/constraint-style score",

  "GERP++", "Conservation/supporting analysis", "Evolutionary conservation score",
  "phyloP", "Conservation/supporting analysis", "Evolutionary conservation score",
  "phastCons", "Conservation/supporting analysis", "Evolutionary conservation score",
  "SiPhy", "Conservation/supporting analysis", "Evolutionary conservation score",
  "fitCons", "Conservation/supporting analysis", "Functional constraint score",
  "Eigen-PC", "Conservation/supporting analysis", "Functional/conservation-based supporting score",

  "Aloft", "Gene-level/LoF supporting analysis", "Loss-of-function/disease mechanism support",
  "LoFtool", "Gene-level/LoF supporting analysis", "Gene-level LoF intolerance score",
  "HIPred", "Gene-level/LoF supporting analysis", "Gene-level haploinsufficiency prediction",
  "GDI", "Gene-level/LoF supporting analysis", "Gene-level damage/intolerance score",

tool_analysis_group_map
```
## add to coverage table

```{r add-analysis-groups-to-coverage-table}
tool_coverage_analysis_groups <- tool_coverage_by_category %>%
  left_join(
    tool_analysis_group_map,
    by = "tool"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_group = ifelse(
      is.na(analysis_group),
      "Unassigned",
      analysis_group
    ),
    reason = ifelse(
      is.na(reason),
      "No downstream analysis group assigned",
      reason
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    analysis_group,
    desc(percent_with_tool_output)
  )

tool_coverage_analysis_groups
```

## summarise tools accprding to analysis group

```{r summarise-coverage-by-analysis-group}
analysis_group_summary <- tool_coverage_analysis_groups %>%
  group_by(analysis_group) %>%
  summarise(
    number_of_tools = n(),
    mean_coverage_percent = round(mean(percent_with_tool_output, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_coverage_percent = round(median(percent_with_tool_output, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    highest_coverage_percent = max(percent_with_tool_output, na.rm = TRUE),
    lowest_coverage_percent = min(percent_with_tool_output, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_coverage_percent))

analysis_group_summary
```

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validate the structure of the reference table
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_columns <- c(
  "tool",
  "tool_classification",
  "score_column",
  "prediction_column",
  "score_type",
  "score_direction",
  "default_threshold",
  "threshold_source",
  "include_in_coverage",
  "include_in_binary_analysis",
  "notes"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  expected_columns,
  names(tool_reference_table)
)

unexpected_columns <- setdiff(
  names(tool_reference_table),
  expected_columns
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The tool reference table is missing these columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(unexpected_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The tool reference table contains unexpected columns: ",
    paste(unexpected_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (nrow(tool_reference_table) == 0) {
  stop("The tool reference table was created but contains no tool records.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(tool_reference_table$tool) > 0) {
  duplicated_tools <- unique(
    tool_reference_table$tool[
      duplicated(tool_reference_table$tool)
    ]
  )

  stop(
    "Duplicate tool names were found: ",
    paste(duplicated_tools, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Confirm successful creation
cat(
  "Tool reference table created successfully.\n",
  "Number of tools:", nrow(tool_reference_table), "\n",
  "Number of variables:", ncol(tool_reference_table), "\n"
)

## dermining the raw sore coverage by individual tool, to determine how many variants have a usable score from each tool 

```{r calculate-raw-score-coverage-by-tool}
raw_score_coverage_by_tool <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(tool_reference_table)),
  function(i) {
    
    current_tool <- tool_reference_table$tool[i]
    current_classification <- tool_reference_table$tool_classification[i]
    current_score_column <- tool_reference_table$score_column[i]
    
    score_values <- ANALYSIS_DATASET[[current_score_column]]
    
    tibble::tibble(
      tool = current_tool,
      tool_classification = current_classification,
      score_column = current_score_column,
      total_variants = nrow(ANALYSIS_DATASET),
      variants_with_score = sum(
        is_usable_tool_value(score_values),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      variants_without_score = total_variants - variants_with_score,
      percent_with_score = round(
        variants_with_score / total_variants * 100,
        1 ))}
) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_with_score), tool)

raw_score_coverage_by_tool %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```  

```{r save-raw-score-coverage-by-tool}
readr::write_csv(
  raw_score_coverage_by_tool,
  file.path(output_directory, "raw_score_coverage_by_tool.csv"))
``` 

```{r plot-raw-score-coverage-by-tool, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
raw_score_coverage_by_tool %>%
  arrange(percent_with_score) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = percent_with_score, y = reorder(tool, percent_with_score))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Raw-score coverage by tool",
    x = "Variants with available score (%)",
    y = "Tool"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

##now coverage is performed across the various variant groups to define the various variant groups

```{r define-variant-groups-strict-updated-consequence}
ANALYSIS_DATASET_WITH_VARIANT_GROUPS <- ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
  mutate(
    effect_function_clean = dplyr::na_if(as.character(Effect_function), ""),
    consequence_clean = dplyr::na_if(as.character(Consequence), ""),

    effect_function_lower = stringr::str_to_lower(effect_function_clean),
    consequence_lower = stringr::str_to_lower(consequence_clean),

    variant_group_missing_effect_function = is.na(effect_function_clean),

    variant_group_missense = !is.na(effect_function_lower) &
  !is.na(consequence_lower) &
  stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "missense") &
  !stringr::str_detect(
    consequence_lower,
    "intron|utr|upstream|downstream|non_coding|regulatory|promoter"),

    variant_group_splice = (
      (!is.na(effect_function_lower) &
         stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "splice")) |
        (!is.na(consequence_lower) &
           stringr::str_detect(consequence_lower, "splice"))
    ),

    variant_group_nonsense_stop = (
      (!is.na(effect_function_lower) &
         stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "stop gained|stop lost|nonsense")) |
        (!is.na(consequence_lower) &
           stringr::str_detect(consequence_lower, "stop_gained|stop_lost"))
    ),

    variant_group_frameshift = (
      (!is.na(effect_function_lower) &
         stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "frameshift|frame shift")) |
        (!is.na(consequence_lower) &
           stringr::str_detect(consequence_lower, "frameshift_variant"))
    ),

    variant_group_inframe_indel = (
      (!is.na(effect_function_lower) &
         stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "inframe indel|inframe insertion|inframe deletion")) |
        (!is.na(consequence_lower) &
           stringr::str_detect(consequence_lower, "inframe_insertion|inframe_deletion"))
    ),

    variant_group_synonymous = (
      (!is.na(effect_function_lower) &
         stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "synonymous|silent")) |
        (!is.na(consequence_lower) &
           stringr::str_detect(consequence_lower, "synonymous_variant"))
    ),

    variant_group_regulatory_noncoding = (
      (!is.na(effect_function_lower) &
         stringr::str_detect(
           effect_function_lower,
           "promoter|utr|rna cleavage|poly\\(a\\)|downstream|upstream|regulatory|intronic|intron"
         )) |
        (!is.na(consequence_lower) &
           stringr::str_detect(
             consequence_lower,
             "intron|utr|upstream|downstream|non_coding|regulatory|promoter"
           ))
    ),

    variant_group_initiation_codon = (
      (!is.na(effect_function_lower) &
         stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "initiation codon|start lost|start gained")) |
        (!is.na(consequence_lower) &
           stringr::str_detect(consequence_lower, "start_lost|start_gained"))
    ),

    variant_group_other = !variant_group_missing_effect_function &
      !(variant_group_missense |
          variant_group_splice |
          variant_group_nonsense_stop |
          variant_group_frameshift |
          variant_group_inframe_indel |
          variant_group_synonymous |
          variant_group_regulatory_noncoding |
          variant_group_initiation_codon))
```

## calculate coverage by tool and variant group

```{r calculate-raw-score-coverage-by-tool-and-variant-group}
raw_score_coverage_by_tool_and_variant_group <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(tool_reference_table)),
  function(i) {
    
    current_tool <- tool_reference_table$tool[i]
    current_classification <- tool_reference_table$tool_classification[i]
    current_score_column <- tool_reference_table$score_column[i]
    
    variant_group_long_dataset %>%
      group_by(variant_group) %>%
      summarise(
        tool = current_tool,
        tool_classification = current_classification,
        score_column = current_score_column,
        total_variants_in_group = n(),
        variants_with_score = sum(
          is_usable_tool_value(.data[[current_score_column]]),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        variants_without_score = total_variants_in_group - variants_with_score,
        percent_with_score = round(
          variants_with_score / total_variants_in_group * 100,
          1
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
) %>%
  arrange(tool, variant_group)

raw_score_coverage_by_tool_and_variant_group %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

##standardise tool labels before performance analysis

```{r create-clean-binary-tool-predictions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# Create clean binary predictions for tool-performance analysis
# ============================================================

clean_numeric_score <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "-", ".", "NA", "na", "N/A")] <- NA
  as.numeric(x)
}

classify_prediction_label <- function(x) {
  
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    
    # Pathogenic-like labels
    x_clean %in% c(
      "d",
      "pathogenic",
      "likely_pathogenic",
      "probably_damaging",
      "possibly_damaging",
      "h",
      "a",
      "s",
      "pp",
      "ps",
      "pm"
    ) ~ "Pathogenic",
    
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^deleterious") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^probably_damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^possibly_damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    
    # MutationTaster mixed labels
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)d(,|$)") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)a(,|$)") ~ "Pathogenic",
    
    # Benign-like labels
    x_clean %in% c(
      "t",
      "b",
      "benign",
      "likely_benign",
      "n",
      "l",
      "bm",
      "bp"
    ) ~ "Benign",
    
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^tolerated") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^benign") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)n(,|$)") ~ "Benign",
    
    # Uncertain labels
    x_clean %in% c(
      "ambiguous",
      "uncertain",
      "uc",
      "m"
    ) ~ NA_character_,
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_mutationassessor_label <- function(x) {
  
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    
    # MutationAssessor-specific labels
    # H = high impact, M = medium impact
    x_clean %in% c("h", "m") ~ "Pathogenic",
    
    # L = low impact, N = neutral
    x_clean %in% c("l", "n") ~ "Benign",
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_popeve_label <- function(x) {
  
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    
    # popEVE-specific labels
    # S = severe/pathogenic-like
    # B = benign-like
    # M = moderate/uncertain, excluded from binary analysis
    x_clean == "s" ~ "Pathogenic",
    x_clean == "b" ~ "Benign",
    x_clean == "m" ~ NA_character_,
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

 # Create binary performance dataset
 
```{r create-binary-performance-dataset, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# =============================================================================
# 1. Validate the source dataset
# =============================================================================

if (!exists("FINAL_MERGED_DATASET")) {
  stop(
    "FINAL_MERGED_DATASET does not exist. ",
    "Run the final merge and classification chunks first."
  )
}

if (!"observed_binary" %in% names(FINAL_MERGED_DATASET)) {
  stop(
    "The column 'observed_binary' is missing from FINAL_MERGED_DATASET."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 2. Validate the helper classification functions
# =============================================================================

required_functions <- c(
  "classify_prediction_label",
  "classify_mutationassessor_label",
  "classify_popeve_label"
)

missing_functions <- required_functions[
  !vapply(
    required_functions,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    mode = "function"
  )
]

if (length(missing_functions) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following classification functions have not been created: ",
    paste(missing_functions, collapse = ", "),
    ". Run their definition chunks first."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 3. Validate the required predictor columns
# =============================================================================

required_predictor_columns <- c(
  "SIFT_new",
  "PolyPhen_new",
  "PolyPhen_score",
  "PROVEAN_pred_new",
  "MutationTaster_pred_new",
  "MutationAssessor_pred_new",
  "MutPred2_pred_new",
  "DEOGEN2_pred_new",
  "PrimateAI_pred_new",
  "ClinPred_pred_new",
  "MetaSVM_pred_new",
  "MetaLR_pred_new",
  "MetaRNN_pred_new",
  "BayesDel_addAF_pred_new",
  "BayesDel_noAF_pred_new",
  "LIST_S2_pred_new",
  "am_class_new",
  "EVE_CLASS_new",
  "ESM1b_pred_new",
  "popEVE_pred_new",
  "CADD_PHRED_new",
  "DANN_score_new",
  "Eigen_PC_phred_coding_new"
)

missing_predictor_columns <- setdiff(
  required_predictor_columns,
  names(FINAL_MERGED_DATASET)
)

if (length(missing_predictor_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required predictor columns are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_predictor_columns, collapse = "\n")
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 4. PolyPhen-2 classification helper
# =============================================================================
# The categorical label is used first.
# The score threshold is used only when the label is missing.

classify_polyphen_label_or_score <- function(
  polyphen_label,
  polyphen_score
) {

  label_clean <- classify_prediction_label(
    polyphen_label
  )

  score_numeric <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      as.character(polyphen_score)
    )
  )

  dplyr::case_when(
    !is.na(label_clean) ~ label_clean,

    is.na(label_clean) &
      !is.na(score_numeric) &
      score_numeric >= 0.453 ~ "Pathogenic",

    is.na(label_clean) &
      !is.na(score_numeric) &
      score_numeric < 0.453 ~ "Benign",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 5. Create the binary performance dataset
# =============================================================================

BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET <- FINAL_MERGED_DATASET %>%

  dplyr::filter(
    observed_binary %in% c(
      "Pathogenic",
      "Benign"
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prediction-label tools
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    SIFT_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        SIFT_new
      ),

    PolyPhen_predicted_clean =
      classify_polyphen_label_or_score(
        polyphen_label = PolyPhen_new,
        polyphen_score = PolyPhen_score
      ),

    PROVEAN_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        PROVEAN_pred_new
      ),

    MutationTaster_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        MutationTaster_pred_new
      ),

    MutationAssessor_predicted_clean =
      classify_mutationassessor_label(
        MutationAssessor_pred_new
      ),

    MutPred2_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        MutPred2_pred_new
      ),

    DEOGEN2_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        DEOGEN2_pred_new
      ),

    PrimateAI_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        PrimateAI_pred_new
      ),

    ClinPred_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        ClinPred_pred_new
      ),

    MetaSVM_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        MetaSVM_pred_new
      ),

    MetaLR_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        MetaLR_pred_new
      ),

    MetaRNN_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        MetaRNN_pred_new
      ),

    BayesDel_addAF_predicted_clean =

      ),

      ),

      ),

    AlphaMissense_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        am_class_new
      ),

    EVE_predicted_clean =

        EVE_CLASS_new
      ),

    ESM1b_predicted_clean =
      classify_prediction_label(
        ESM1b_pred_new
      ),

    popEVE_predicted_clean =
      classify_popeve_label(
        popEVE_pred_new
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Convert continuous scores to numeric
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    CADD_score_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        as.character(CADD_PHRED_new)
      )
    ),

    DANN_score_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        as.character(DANN_score_new)
      )
    ),

    Eigen_PC_score_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        as.character(Eigen_PC_phred_coding_new)
      )
    ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Continuous-score tools using the thresholds from your original analysis
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    CADD_predicted_clean = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(CADD_score_numeric) &
        CADD_score_numeric >= 10.44 ~ "Pathogenic",

      !is.na(CADD_score_numeric) &
        CADD_score_numeric < 10.44 ~ "Benign",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    DANN_predicted_clean = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(DANN_score_numeric) &
        DANN_score_numeric >= 0.971 ~ "Pathogenic",

      !is.na(DANN_score_numeric) &
        DANN_score_numeric < 0.971 ~ "Benign",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Eigen_PC_predicted_clean = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(Eigen_PC_score_numeric) &
        Eigen_PC_score_numeric >= 1.3 ~ "Pathogenic",

      !is.na(Eigen_PC_score_numeric) &
        Eigen_PC_score_numeric < 1.3 ~ "Benign",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```{r define-polyphen-specific-classifier}
classify_polyphen_label_or_score <- function(polyphen_label, polyphen_score) {
  
  label_clean <- classify_prediction_label(polyphen_label)
  score_numeric <- as.numeric(polyphen_score)
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    !is.na(label_clean) ~ label_clean,
    is.na(label_clean) & !is.na(score_numeric) & score_numeric >= 0.453 ~ "Pathogenic",
    is.na(label_clean) & !is.na(score_numeric) & score_numeric < 0.453 ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

```{r define-safe-binary-performance-function}

safe_divide <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  ifelse(
    denominator == 0,
    NA_real_,
    numerator / denominator
  )
}

calculate_binary_tool_performance <- function(
  data,
  observed_col,
  predicted_col,
  tool_name
) {

  performance_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[observed_col]]),
      !is.na(.data[[predicted_col]])
    )

  TP <- sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Pathogenic" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Pathogenic",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  TN <- sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Benign" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Benign",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  FP <- sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Benign" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Pathogenic",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  FN <- sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Pathogenic" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Benign",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # Convert counts to numeric before multiplication
  TP <- as.numeric(TP)
  TN <- as.numeric(TN)
  FP <- as.numeric(FP)
  FN <- as.numeric(FN)

  n_evaluated <- TP + TN + FP + FN

  sensitivity <- safe_divide(TP, TP + FN)
  specificity <- safe_divide(TN, TN + FP)

  mcc_denominator <- sqrt(
    (TP + FP) *
      (TP + FN) *
      (TN + FP) *
      (TN + FN)
  )

  mcc <- safe_divide(
    (TP * TN) - (FP * FN),
    mcc_denominator
  )

  LR_positive <- safe_divide(
    sensitivity,
    1 - specificity
  )

  LR_negative <- safe_divide(
    1 - sensitivity,
    specificity
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    tool = tool_name,
    prediction_column = predicted_col,
    total_eligible_binary_variants = nrow(data),
    n_evaluated = n_evaluated,
    variants_not_evaluated =
      nrow(data) - n_evaluated,
    true_positive = TP,
    true_negative = TN,
    false_positive = FP,
    false_negative = FN,
    accuracy = round(
      safe_divide(
        TP + TN,
        n_evaluated
      ),
      3
    ),
    sensitivity = round(
      sensitivity,
      3
    ),
    specificity = round(
      specificity,
      3
    ),
    ppv = round(
      safe_divide(
        TP,
        TP + FP
      ),
      3
    ),
    npv = round(
      safe_divide(
        TN,
        TN + FN
      ),
      3
    ),
    balanced_accuracy = round(
      ifelse(
        is.na(sensitivity) |
          is.na(specificity),
        NA_real_,
        mean(
          c(
            sensitivity,
            specificity
          ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      ),
      3
    ),
    mcc = round(
      mcc,
      3
    ),
    LR_positive = round(
      LR_positive,
      3
    ),
    LR_negative = round(
      LR_negative,
      3
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "Safe binary performance function created successfully.\n"
)

```

)

```{r create-missense-binary-performance-dataset}

if (!exists("BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET")) {
  stop(
    "BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET does not exist. ",
    "Run the binary performance dataset chunk first."
  )
}

if (!"Effect_function" %in%
    names(BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET)) {
  stop(
    "Effect_function is missing from ",
    "BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET."
  )
}

MISSENSE_BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET <-
  BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effect_function_lower =
      stringr::str_to_lower(Effect_function)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(
      effect_function_lower,
      "missense"
    )
  )

if (nrow(MISSENSE_BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No missense variants were found in ",
    "BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET."
  )
}

MISSENSE_BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_missense_binary_variants = dplyr::n(),
    pathogenic_reference = sum(
      observed_binary == "Pathogenic",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    benign_reference = sum(
      observed_binary == "Benign",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ))
```

 ## Whole-dataset versus missense-only performance comparison

This section compares the performance of each tool in the full binary dataset and in the missense-only subset. This helps determine whether tools designed mainly for missense variants perform differently when restricted to their intended variant class.

```{r compare-whole-dataset-and-missense-performance-summary-final}
whole_vs_missense_performance_comparison_summary <- whole_vs_missense_performance_comparison %>%
  select(
    tool,
    whole_dataset_evaluated,
    whole_dataset_mcc,
    missense_evaluated,
    missense_mcc,
    mcc_change_missense_minus_whole,
    whole_dataset_balanced_accuracy,
    missense_balanced_accuracy,
    balanced_accuracy_change_missense_minus_whole
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missense_mcc))

whole_vs_missense_performance_comparison_summary %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r save-whole-vs-missense-performance-comparison-summary-final}
readr::write_csv(
  whole_vs_missense_performance_comparison_summary,
  file.path(output_directory, "whole_vs_missense_performance_comparison_summary.csv")
)
```

### Interpretation

Comparison of whole-dataset and missense-only binary performance showed that tool rankings were generally stable after restricting the analysis to missense variants. MutPred2 remained the highest-performing tool by MCC in both analyses, with only a minimal change in MCC between the whole dataset and the missense-only subset. AlphaMissense also showed stable performance and remained one of the top-ranked tools, indicating that its performance was not strongly altered by restricting the analysis to missense variants.

CADD also performed strongly after correction of the MCC calculation, with a whole-dataset MCC of 0.484 and a missense-only MCC of 0.456. However, despite its high sensitivity, CADD showed lower specificity, indicating that it was more effective at identifying pathogenic variants than benign variants in this dataset.

Most tools showed only small differences in MCC and balanced accuracy between the two analyses. This suggests that the binary-evaluable variants for many tools were already largely concentrated among missense variants. Overall, the missense-only analysis confirmed that MutPred2, CADD, AlphaMissense and Eigen-PC were among the strongest-performing tools, while several other predictors showed high sensitivity but limited specificity.  

### 4. Whole-dataset versus missense-only MCC comparison

This shows whether tools changed when restricted to missense variants.

```{r plot-whole-vs-missense-mcc, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
whole_vs_missense_performance_comparison %>%
  filter(!is.na(whole_dataset_mcc), !is.na(missense_mcc)) %>%
  select(tool, whole_dataset_mcc, missense_mcc) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(whole_dataset_mcc, missense_mcc),
    names_to = "analysis_type",
    values_to = "mcc"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_type = dplyr::recode(
      analysis_type,
      whole_dataset_mcc = "Whole dataset",
      missense_mcc = "Missense only"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mcc, y = reorder(tool, mcc), fill = analysis_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Whole-dataset versus missense-only MCC",
    x = "Matthews correlation coefficient",
    y = "Tool",
    fill = "Analysis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

    ada_score_min = min(clean_numeric_score(ada_score_new), na.rm = TRUE),
    ada_score_median = median(clean_numeric_score(ada_score_new), na.rm = TRUE),
    ada_score_max = max(clean_numeric_score(ada_score_new), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    rf_score_available = sum(is_usable_tool_value(rf_score_new), na.rm = TRUE),
    rf_score_min = min(clean_numeric_score(rf_score_new), na.rm = TRUE),
    rf_score_median = median(clean_numeric_score(rf_score_new), na.rm = TRUE),
    rf_score_max = max(clean_numeric_score(rf_score_new), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

##Determine if tools with low score have truly low evaluable samples

##helper chunk
```{r helper-chunk}
clean_numeric_score <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "-", ".", "NA", "na", "N/A")] <- NA
  as.numeric(x)
}

classify_prediction_label <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  x_clean <- stringr::str_trim(x_clean)
  x_clean <- stringr::str_replace_all(x_clean, " ", "_")
  x_clean <- stringr::str_replace_all(x_clean, "-", "_")

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,

    x_clean %in% c(
      "d", "pathogenic", "likely_pathogenic",
      "probably_damaging", "possibly_damaging",
      "damaging", "deleterious",
      "h", "a", "s", "pp", "ps", "pm"
    ) ~ "Pathogenic",

    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "probably_damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "possibly_damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^deleterious") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)d(,|$)") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)a(,|$)") ~ "Pathogenic",

    x_clean %in% c(
      "t", "b", "benign", "likely_benign",
      "tolerated", "neutral",
      "n", "l", "bm", "bp"
    ) ~ "Benign",

    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^tolerated") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^benign") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^neutral") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)n(,|$)") ~ "Benign",

    x_clean %in% c("ambiguous", "uncertain", "unknown", "uc", "m") ~ NA_character_,

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_mutationassessor_label <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  x_clean <- stringr::str_trim(x_clean)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("h", "m", "high", "medium") ~ "Pathogenic",
    x_clean %in% c("l", "n", "low", "neutral") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_popeve_label <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  x_clean <- stringr::str_trim(x_clean)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean == "s" ~ "Pathogenic",
    x_clean == "b" ~ "Benign",
    x_clean == "m" ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_polyphen_label_or_score <- function(polyphen_label, polyphen_score) {
  label_clean <- classify_prediction_label(polyphen_label)
  score_numeric <- as.numeric(polyphen_score)

  dplyr::case_when(
    !is.na(label_clean) ~ label_clean,
    is.na(label_clean) & !is.na(score_numeric) & score_numeric >= 0.453 ~ "Pathogenic",
    is.na(label_clean) & !is.na(score_numeric) & score_numeric < 0.453 ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
```


##create tool-level coverage QC table
```{r tool-level-binary-coverage-qc}
count_binary_tool_coverage <- function(data, tool_name, raw_score_col, prediction_col) {
  
  raw_score_exists <- raw_score_col %in% names(data)
  prediction_exists <- !is.na(prediction_col) && prediction_col %in% names(data)
  
  total_eligible_binary_variants <- nrow(data)
  
  variants_with_raw_score <- if (raw_score_exists) {
    sum(is_usable_tool_value(data[[raw_score_col]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    0
  }
  
  variants_with_binary_prediction <- if (prediction_exists) {
    sum(
      classify_prediction_label(data[[prediction_col]]) %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_integer_
  }
  
  variants_with_uncertain_prediction <- if (prediction_exists) {
    sum(
      is_usable_tool_value(data[[prediction_col]]) &
        is.na(classify_prediction_label(data[[prediction_col]])),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NA_integer_
  }
  
  variants_missing_raw_score <- total_eligible_binary_variants - variants_with_raw_score
  
  tibble(
    tool = tool_name,
    raw_score_col = raw_score_col,
    prediction_col = prediction_col,
    total_eligible_binary_variants = total_eligible_binary_variants,
    variants_with_raw_score = variants_with_raw_score,
    variants_missing_raw_score = variants_missing_raw_score,
    variants_with_binary_prediction = variants_with_binary_prediction,
    variants_with_uncertain_prediction = variants_with_uncertain_prediction,
    percent_with_raw_score = round(
      variants_with_raw_score / total_eligible_binary_variants * 100,
      1
    ),
    percent_with_binary_prediction = round(
      variants_with_binary_prediction / total_eligible_binary_variants * 100,
      1
    ),
    percent_uncertain_prediction = round(
      variants_with_uncertain_prediction / total_eligible_binary_variants * 100,
      1))}

tool_level_binary_coverage_qc <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  binary_tool_qc_map,
  function(tool, raw_score_col, prediction_col, raw_score_col_exists, prediction_col_exists) {
    count_binary_tool_coverage(
      data = BINARY_REFERENCE_DATASET,
      tool_name = tool,
      raw_score_col = raw_score_col,
      prediction_col = prediction_col)})
```

```{r define-confusion-status-helper}
classify_confusion_status <- function(observed, predicted) {
  case_when(
    observed == "Pathogenic" & predicted == "Pathogenic" ~ "TP",
    observed == "Benign" & predicted == "Benign" ~ "TN",
    observed == "Benign" & predicted == "Pathogenic" ~ "FP",
    observed == "Pathogenic" & predicted == "Benign" ~ "FN",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)}
```

## score directon logic for ESM1b and EVE ,popEVE related scored to ensure R is applying thresholds in the correct direction

# Higher score = more damaging
ifelse(score >= threshold, "Pathogenic", "Benign")

# Lower score = more damaging
ifelse(score <= threshold, "Pathogenic", "Benign")


```{r define-score-direction-reference-table}
score_direction_reference_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~tool, ~score_column, ~pathogenic_score_direction, ~threshold_condition, ~notes,

  "SIFT", "SIFT_score", "lower", "score <= threshold", "Lower SIFT scores indicate lower tolerance / greater predicted damage",
  "PolyPhen-2", "PolyPhen_score", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher PolyPhen-2 scores indicate greater predicted damage",
  "PROVEAN", "PROVEAN_score_new", "lower", "score <= threshold", "Lower PROVEAN scores indicate greater predicted damage",
  "MutationAssessor", "MutationAssessor_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted functional impact",
  "MutPred2", "MutPred2_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "DEOGEN2", "DEOGEN2_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "PrimateAI", "PrimateAI_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted pathogenicity",
  "REVEL", "REVEL_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted pathogenicity",
  "ClinPred", "ClinPred_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted pathogenicity",
  "MetaSVM", "MetaSVM_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "MetaLR", "MetaLR_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "MetaRNN", "MetaRNN_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "BayesDel addAF", "BayesDel_addAF_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "BayesDel noAF", "BayesDel_noAF_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "LIST-S2", "LIST_S2_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "CADD", "CADD_PHRED_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher PHRED-like score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "DANN", "DANN_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "Eigen-PC", "Eigen_PC_phred_coding_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "Eigen", "Eigen_phred_coding_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "MVP", "MVP_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "MPC", "MPC_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "gMVP", "gMVP_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "VEST4", "VEST4_score_seperated", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",
  "Condel", "Condel_score", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted deleteriousness",

  "AlphaMissense", "am_pathogenicity_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher AlphaMissense pathogenicity score indicates greater predicted pathogenicity",
  "EVE", "EVE_SCORE_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Likely higher score indicates greater predicted pathogenicity; confirm exact dbNSFP field definition",
  "ESM1b", "ESM1b_score_new", "lower", "score <= threshold", "Lower or more negative score indicates greater predicted damage",
  "popEVE", "popEVE_SCORE_1_new", "lower", "score <= threshold", "Lower score likely indicates greater predicted damage; confirm exact field definition",

  "SpliceAI", "SpliceAI_DS", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher delta score indicates greater predicted splice impact",
  "SpliceAI acceptor gain", "SpliceAI_pred_DS_AG_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher delta score indicates greater predicted splice impact",
  "SpliceAI acceptor loss", "SpliceAI_pred_DS_AL_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher delta score indicates greater predicted splice impact",
  "SpliceAI donor gain", "SpliceAI_pred_DS_DG_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher delta score indicates greater predicted splice impact",
  "SpliceAI donor loss", "SpliceAI_pred_DS_DL_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher delta score indicates greater predicted splice impact",

  "ada_score", "ada_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted splice impact",
  "rf_score", "rf_score_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher score indicates greater predicted splice impact",

  "GERP++", "GERP__RS_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher conservation score may indicate functional constraint; interpret cautiously",
  "phyloP100way", "phyloP100way_vertebrate_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher conservation score may indicate functional constraint; interpret cautiously",
  "phastCons100way", "phastCons100way_vertebrate_new", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher conservation score may indicate functional constraint; interpret cautiously",
  "SiPhy", "SiPhy_29way_logOdds", "higher", "score >= threshold", "Higher conservation score may indicate functional constraint; interpret cautiously"
)

## defining threshold classification functions
```{r define-score-threshold-classification-function}
classify_score_by_direction <- function(score, threshold, pathogenic_score_direction) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(score) | is.na(threshold) | is.na(pathogenic_score_direction) ~ NA_character_,

    pathogenic_score_direction == "higher" & score >= threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
    pathogenic_score_direction == "higher" & score < threshold ~ "Benign",

    pathogenic_score_direction == "lower" & score <= threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
    pathogenic_score_direction == "lower" & score > threshold ~ "Benign",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )}
```

## define optimisation function

```{r define-threshold-optimisation-function-corrected}
optimise_threshold_for_tool <- function(data, tool_name, score_column, pathogenic_score_direction) {

  optimisation_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      observed_binary %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"),
      !is.na(.data[[score_column]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      score = as.numeric(.data[[score_column]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score))

  if (nrow(optimisation_data) < 10) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        tool = tool_name,
        score_column = score_column,
        pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction,
        n_evaluated = nrow(optimisation_data),
        optimised_threshold = NA_real_,
        accuracy = NA_real_,
        sensitivity = NA_real_,
        specificity = NA_real_,
        balanced_accuracy = NA_real_,
        mcc = NA_real_,
        LR_positive = NA_real_,
        LR_negative = NA_real_,
        note = "Fewer than 10 variants with score available"
      )
    )
  }

  candidate_thresholds <- sort(unique(optimisation_data$score))

  threshold_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
    candidate_thresholds,
    function(candidate_threshold) {

      temp_data <- optimisation_data %>%
        mutate(
          predicted_binary = classify_score_by_direction(
            score = score,
            threshold = candidate_threshold,
            pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction
          )
        )

      calculate_binary_tool_performance(
        data = temp_data,
        observed_col = "observed_binary",
        predicted_col = "predicted_binary",
        tool_name = tool_name
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          optimised_threshold = candidate_threshold,
          pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction
        )
    }
  )

  best_threshold_result <- threshold_results %>%
    arrange(
      desc(mcc),
      desc(balanced_accuracy),
      desc(specificity)
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    mutate(
      score_column = score_column,
      note = "Selected by maximum MCC; balanced accuracy and specificity used as tie-breakers"
    ) %>%
    select(
      tool,
      score_column,
      pathogenic_score_direction,
      optimised_threshold,
      n_evaluated,
      accuracy,
      sensitivity,
      specificity,
      balanced_accuracy,
      mcc,
      LR_positive,
      LR_negative,
      note
    )

  best_threshold_result
}
```

## Exploratory threshold optimisation

After evaluating tool performance using default or tool-provided thresholds, an exploratory threshold optimisation analysis was performed. For each tool with a continuous numeric score and interpretable score direction, multiple candidate thresholds were tested. At each threshold, variants were classified as pathogenic-like or benign-like and binary performance metrics were calculated. The threshold with the highest Matthews correlation coefficient was selected as the dataset-optimised threshold.

This analysis was considered exploratory because the optimised thresholds were selected using the same dataset on which performance was evaluated. Therefore, these thresholds were not interpreted as clinically validated cut-offs, but rather as a way to assess whether tool performance could improve under alternative decision thresholds.


```{r define-threshold-optimisation-functions}
calculate_threshold_performance <- function(data, observed_col, score_col, threshold, direction, tool_name) {
  
  threshold_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      score_numeric = clean_numeric_score(.data[[score_col]]),
      
      predicted_threshold = case_when(
        is.na(score_numeric) ~ NA_character_,
        direction == "higher_pathogenic" & score_numeric >= threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
        direction == "higher_pathogenic" & score_numeric < threshold ~ "Benign",
        direction == "lower_pathogenic" & score_numeric <= threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
        direction == "lower_pathogenic" & score_numeric > threshold ~ "Benign",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[observed_col]]),
      !is.na(predicted_threshold)
    )
  
  TP <- sum(
    threshold_data[[observed_col]] == "Pathogenic" &
      threshold_data$predicted_threshold == "Pathogenic",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  TN <- sum(
    threshold_data[[observed_col]] == "Benign" &
      threshold_data$predicted_threshold == "Benign",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  FP <- sum(
    threshold_data[[observed_col]] == "Benign" &
      threshold_data$predicted_threshold == "Pathogenic",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  FN <- sum(
    threshold_data[[observed_col]] == "Pathogenic" &
      threshold_data$predicted_threshold == "Benign",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  n_evaluated <- TP + TN + FP + FN
  
  sensitivity <- safe_divide(TP, TP + FN)
  specificity <- safe_divide(TN, TN + FP)
  
  mcc_denominator <- sqrt(
    as.numeric(TP + FP) *
      as.numeric(TP + FN) *
      as.numeric(TN + FP) *
      as.numeric(TN + FN)
  )
  
  mcc <- safe_divide(
    as.numeric((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)),
    mcc_denominator
  )
  
  LR_positive <- safe_divide(sensitivity, 1 - specificity)
  LR_negative <- safe_divide(1 - sensitivity, specificity)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    tool = tool_name,
    score_column = score_col,
    threshold = threshold,
    direction = direction,
    n_evaluated = n_evaluated,
    true_positive = TP,
    true_negative = TN,
    false_positive = FP,
    false_negative = FN,
    accuracy = round(safe_divide(TP + TN, n_evaluated), 3),
    sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
    specificity = round(specificity, 3),
    balanced_accuracy = round(
      ifelse(
        is.na(sensitivity) | is.na(specificity),
        NA_real_,
        mean(c(sensitivity, specificity))
      ),
      3
    ),
    mcc = round(mcc, 3),
    LR_positive = round(LR_positive, 3),
    LR_negative = round(LR_negative, 3)
  )
}


optimise_threshold_for_tool <- function(data, observed_col, score_col, direction, tool_name) {
  
  score_values <- data %>%
    mutate(
      score_numeric = clean_numeric_score(.data[[score_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score_numeric)) %>%
    pull(score_numeric)
  
  candidate_thresholds <- sort(unique(score_values))
  
  threshold_results <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      candidate_thresholds,
      function(current_threshold) {
        calculate_threshold_performance(
          data = data,
          observed_col = observed_col,
          score_col = score_col,
          threshold = current_threshold,
          direction = direction,
          tool_name = tool_name)}))
  
  threshold_results %>%
    filter(n_evaluated >= 50) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(mcc),
      desc(balanced_accuracy),
      desc(specificity)
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)}
```

## Tools excluded from threshold optimisation

Not all tools were suitable for threshold optimisation. Threshold optimisation was restricted to tools with a continuous numeric score and an interpretable score direction. Tools without a numeric score, tools represented only by categorical prediction labels, and tools with uncertain score direction were not optimised.

```{r identify-tools-not-used-in-threshold-optimisation-final}
tools_not_used_in_threshold_optimisation <- tool_reference_table %>%
  mutate(
    has_score_column = !is.na(score_column) & score_column %in% names(BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET),
    has_clear_score_direction = case_when(
      is.na(score_direction) ~ FALSE,
      stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_to_lower(score_direction), "to confirm") ~ FALSE,
      stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_to_lower(score_direction), "higher") ~ TRUE,
      stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_to_lower(score_direction), "lower") ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    included_in_threshold_optimisation = tool %in% threshold_optimisation_candidates_all_tools$tool,
    reason_not_optimised = case_when(
      included_in_threshold_optimisation ~ "Included in threshold optimisation",
      !has_score_column ~ "No usable numeric score column available",
      !has_clear_score_direction ~ "Score direction unclear or requires confirmation",
      TRUE ~ "Not included for another reason"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!included_in_threshold_optimisation) %>%
  select(
    tool,
    tool_classification,
    score_column,
    prediction_column,
    score_direction,
    reason_not_optimised
  ) %>%
  arrange(tool_classification, tool)

tools_not_used_in_threshold_optimisation %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```



### Interpretation

Tools excluded from threshold optimisation were not necessarily excluded from the overall analysis. Some were evaluated using their existing binary or categorical prediction labels, while others were excluded from threshold optimisation because they lacked a usable continuous score or had unclear score direction. Therefore, threshold optimisation represents an exploratory analysis of score-based tools only, not a replacement for the main binary performance analysis.

```{r compare-original-and-updated-annotation-summary}
compare_original_updated_column <- function(data, original_col, updated_col) {
  
  comparison_data <- data %>%
    transmute(
      variant_id = dplyr::coalesce(
        as.character(.data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]]),
        as.character(.data[["Vep_input"]]),
        as.character(HGVS),
        as.character(HGVS_transcript)
      ),
      HGVS = HGVS,
      HGVS_transcript = HGVS_transcript,
      Effect_function = Effect_function,
      Observed_pathogenicity = Observed_pathogenicity,
      original_value = as.character(.data[[original_col]]),
      updated_value = as.character(.data[[updated_col]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      original_clean = dplyr::na_if(original_value, ""),
      updated_clean = dplyr::na_if(updated_value, ""),
      original_clean = dplyr::na_if(original_clean, "-"),
      updated_clean = dplyr::na_if(updated_clean, "-"),
      
      comparison_status = case_when(
        is.na(original_clean) & is.na(updated_clean) ~ "Missing in both",
        !is.na(original_clean) & is.na(updated_clean) ~ "Present originally, missing in updated",
        is.na(original_clean) & !is.na(updated_clean) ~ "Missing originally, present in updated",
        original_clean == updated_clean ~ "Same value",
        original_clean != updated_clean ~ "Different value",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
  
  comparison_data %>%
    count(comparison_status, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(
      tool_column_original = original_col,
      tool_column_updated = updated_col,
      total_variants = sum(n),
      percentage = round(n / total_variants * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    select(
      tool_column_original,
      tool_column_updated,
      comparison_status,
      n,
      total_variants,
      percentage
    )
}


original_updated_annotation_comparison_summary <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  original_updated_comparison_pairs$original_column,
  original_updated_comparison_pairs$updated_column,
  ~ compare_original_updated_column(
    data = ANALYSIS_DATASET,
    original_col = .x,
    updated_col = .y
  )
)

original_updated_annotation_comparison_summary %>%
  arrange(tool_column_original, comparison_status) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## create the variant-level difference function 

```{r create-original-updated-difference-table}
create_original_updated_difference_table <- function(data, original_col, updated_col) {
  
  data %>%
    transmute(
      tool_column_original = original_col,
      tool_column_updated = updated_col,
      variant_id = dplyr::coalesce(
        as.character(.data[["GRCh38 Vep_input"]]),
        as.character(.data[["Vep_input"]]),
        as.character(HGVS),
        as.character(HGVS_transcript)
      ),
      HGVS = HGVS,
      HGVS_transcript = HGVS_transcript,
      Effect_function = Effect_function,
      Observed_pathogenicity = Observed_pathogenicity,
      original_value = as.character(.data[[original_col]]),
      updated_value = as.character(.data[[updated_col]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      original_clean = dplyr::na_if(original_value, ""),
      updated_clean = dplyr::na_if(updated_value, ""),
      original_clean = dplyr::na_if(original_clean, "-"),
      updated_clean = dplyr::na_if(updated_clean, "-"),
      
      comparison_status = case_when(
        is.na(original_clean) & is.na(updated_clean) ~ "Missing in both",
        !is.na(original_clean) & is.na(updated_clean) ~ "Present originally, missing in updated",
        is.na(original_clean) & !is.na(updated_clean) ~ "Missing originally, present in updated",
        original_clean == updated_clean ~ "Same value",
        original_clean != updated_clean ~ "Different value",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(comparison_status != "Same value")
}


original_updated_variant_level_differences <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  original_updated_comparison_pairs$original_column,
  original_updated_comparison_pairs$updated_column,
  ~ create_original_updated_difference_table(
    data = ANALYSIS_DATASET,
    original_col = .x,
    updated_col = .y
  )
)

original_updated_variant_level_differences %>%
  print(n = 100, width = Inf)

```
