## Summary of original versus updated annotation differences

This section summarises the comparison between original and updated annotation values. The aim is to identify which tools showed the largest changes after re-annotation.

```{r summarise-original-updated-differences-by-tool}
original_updated_difference_summary_by_tool <- original_updated_annotation_comparison_summary %>%
  group_by(
    tool_column_original,
    tool_column_updated
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_variants = max(total_variants, na.rm = TRUE),
    same_value = sum(n[comparison_status == "Same value"], na.rm = TRUE),
    different_value = sum(n[comparison_status == "Different value"], na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_in_both = sum(n[comparison_status == "Missing in both"], na.rm = TRUE),
    present_originally_missing_updated = sum(n[comparison_status == "Present originally, missing in updated"], na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_originally_present_updated = sum(n[comparison_status == "Missing originally, present in updated"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_same = round(same_value / total_variants * 100, 1),
    percent_different = round(different_value / total_variants * 100, 1),
    percent_newly_available = round(missing_originally_present_updated / total_variants * 100, 1),
    percent_lost_in_updated = round(present_originally_missing_updated / total_variants * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_different), desc(percent_newly_available))

original_updated_difference_summary_by_tool %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r save-original-updated-difference-summary-by-tool}
readr::write_csv(
  original_updated_difference_summary_by_tool,
  file.path(output_directory, "original_updated_difference_summary_by_tool.csv")
)
```

```{r top-original-updated-difference-tools}
    desc(different_value),
    desc(missing_originally_present_updated),
    desc(present_originally_missing_updated)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

top_original_updated_difference_tools %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r save-top-original-updated-difference-tools}
  top_original_updated_difference_tools,
  file.path(output_directory, "top_original_updated_difference_tools.csv")
)
```

### Interpretation

Comparison of original and updated annotation columns showed substantial differences for several tools. Location and Gene showed the highest apparent differences, but these likely reflect changes in annotation format, genome build, or VEP-derived representation rather than direct changes in prediction scores.

Among score-based predictors, CADD showed the largest difference between original and updated annotations, with 79.0% of variants having different values. DANN, MutationTaster, phastCons17way_primate and phyloP100way_vertebrate also showed substantial differences, with approximately 63–64% of variants differing between the original and updated datasets. Moderate differences were observed for ClinPred, MetaLR, REVEL, MetaSVM and BayesDel addAF.

In contrast, splice-related tools such as ada_score, MaxEntScan_diff and rf_score showed fewer changed values, although most variants were missing in both the original and updated annotations for these tools. These findings suggest that re-annotation using the updated VEP/dbNSFP workflow substantially changed several tool scores, particularly for general deleteriousness, conservation and meta-predictor annotations.

This section excludes general annotation fields such as `Location`, `Gene`, and `Consequence`, and focuses only on score-based predictor columns.


### Interpretation

After excluding general annotation fields such as `Location`, `Gene`, and `Consequence`, the largest original-versus-updated differences were observed for score-based predictors. CADD_PHRED showed the greatest change, with 79.0% of variants having different updated values. MutationTaster_score, phastCons17way_primate, phyloP100way_vertebrate and DANN_score also showed substantial differences, with approximately 63–64% of variants differing between the original and updated annotations.

Moderate differences were observed for ClinPred_score, MetaLR_score, REVEL_score, MetaSVM_score and BayesDel_addAF_score. Splice-related tools such as ada_score, MaxEntScan_diff and rf_score showed fewer changed values, although most variants were missing in both original and updated annotations for these tools.

These findings indicate that re-annotation using the updated VEP/dbNSFP workflow substantially affected several predictor scores. Therefore, differences between the current analysis and the original publication may reflect updated annotation databases, genome-build conversion, transcript representation, or tool-version changes.


```{r top-changed-score-tools-original-vs-updated}
top_changed_score_tools_original_vs_updated <- score_only_original_updated_difference_summary %>%

    tool_column_updated,

    missing_in_both,
```

```{r save-top-changed-score-tools-original-vs-updated}
  file.path(output_directory, "top_changed_score_tools_original_vs_updated.csv")
)
```

### Interpretation

After excluding general annotation fields, the largest original-versus-updated differences were observed for score-based predictors. CADD_PHRED showed the greatest change, with 1286 of 1627 variants having different updated values. This corresponded to 79.0% of the dataset. MutationTaster_score, phastCons17way_primate, phyloP100way_vertebrate and DANN_score also showed substantial differences, with approximately 63–64% of variants differing between the original and updated annotations.

Moderate differences were observed for ClinPred_score, MetaLR_score, REVEL_score, MetaSVM_score and BayesDel_addAF_score. These results indicate that re-annotation using the updated VEP/dbNSFP workflow substantially changed several predictor scores that were also present in the original dataset.

Splice-related scores, including ada_score, MaxEntScan_diff and rf_score, showed fewer changed values. However, most variants were missing in both the original and updated annotations for these tools, consistent with their more specific relevance to splice-altering variants.

Overall, this comparison suggests that differences between the current analysis and the original publication may reflect updated annotation databases, genome-build conversion, transcript representation, and tool-version changes rather than only differences in downstream analysis methods.

## cleaned top improved table to help with results section
```{r top-tools-improved-by-threshold-optimisation}
top_tools_improved_by_threshold_optimisation <- default_vs_corrected_optimised_threshold_comparison %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(mcc_change)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mcc_change)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

top_tools_improved_by_threshold_optimisation %>%
  select(
    tool,
    default_mcc,
    optimised_mcc,
    mcc_change,
    default_n_evaluated,
    optimised_n_evaluated,
    evaluated_n_change
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

### Interpretation

Comparison of default and dataset-optimised threshold performance showed that several tools improved after threshold optimisation, particularly PrimateAI, BayesDel addAF, BayesDel noAF, EVE, DEOGEN2, MetaRNN and MutationAssessor. This suggests that the default or tool-provided classifications for these predictors may not represent the optimal decision threshold for this haemoglobinopathy variant dataset.

CADD showed no improvement after optimisation, as its optimised threshold was very close to the default threshold used in the main analysis. This suggests that the selected CADD threshold was already close to the dataset-derived optimum. DANN showed only minimal improvement after optimisation.

In contrast, MutPred2, AlphaMissense and SIFT showed lower MCC values after optimisation, indicating that their tool-provided classifications performed better than simple numeric score thresholding in this dataset. Therefore, the default or tool-provided classifications remain more appropriate for these tools in the main analysis.

Overall, threshold optimisation demonstrated that some tools are sensitive to threshold choice, while others perform best using their existing classifications. Because the optimised thresholds were selected using the same dataset on which performance was evaluated, these results should be interpreted as exploratory and require independent validation before any clinical application.

```{r compare-default-vs-optimised-thresholds}
default_vs_corrected_optimised_threshold_comparison <- binary_tool_performance_summary %>%

    default_specificity = specificity,
    default_balanced_accuracy = balanced_accuracy,

  ) %>%
  inner_join(

      select(

  ) %>%
```

## calculating likelihood ratio
```{r add-safe-likelihood-ratios-to-binary-performance}
binary_tool_performance_summary <- binary_tool_performance_summary %>%
  mutate(
    LR_positive = case_when(
      is.na(sensitivity) | is.na(specificity) ~ NA_real_,
      false_positive == 0 & true_positive == 0 ~ NA_real_,
      false_positive == 0 & true_positive > 0 ~ Inf,
      specificity == 1 ~ Inf,
      TRUE ~ sensitivity / (1 - specificity)
    ),
    
    LR_negative = case_when(
      is.na(sensitivity) | is.na(specificity) ~ NA_real_,
      true_negative == 0 & false_negative == 0 ~ NA_real_,
      specificity == 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ (1 - sensitivity) / specificity
    ),
    
    LR_positive_display = case_when(
      is.na(LR_positive) ~ NA_character_,
      is.infinite(LR_positive) ~ "Inf",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(LR_positive, 3))
    ),
    
    LR_negative_display = case_when(
      is.na(LR_negative) ~ NA_character_,
      is.infinite(LR_negative) ~ "Inf",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(LR_negative, 3))
    )
  )

binary_tool_performance_summary %>%
  select(
    tool,
    sensitivity,
    specificity,
    true_positive,
    false_positive,
    true_negative,
    false_negative,
    LR_positive_display,
    LR_negative_display
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r interpret-safe-likelihood-ratios}
binary_tool_performance_summary <- binary_tool_performance_summary %>%
  mutate(
    LR_positive_interpretation = case_when(
      is.na(LR_positive) ~ "Not interpretable",
      is.infinite(LR_positive) & true_positive > 0 & false_positive == 0 ~
        "Infinite LR+ due to zero false positives; interpret cautiously",
      LR_positive < 1 ~
        "Evidence against pathogenic-like prediction",
      LR_positive >= 1 & LR_positive < 2 ~
        "Limited or no pathogenic-like support",
      LR_positive >= 2 & LR_positive < 5 ~
        "Weak pathogenic-like support",
      LR_positive >= 5 & LR_positive < 10 ~
        "Moderate pathogenic-like support",
      LR_positive >= 10 ~
        "Strong pathogenic-like support",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    LR_negative_interpretation = case_when(
      is.na(LR_negative) ~ "Not interpretable",
      LR_negative > 1 ~
        "Evidence against benign-like prediction",
      LR_negative <= 1 & LR_negative > 0.5 ~
        "Limited or no benign-like support",
      LR_negative <= 0.5 & LR_negative > 0.2 ~
        "Weak benign-like support",
      LR_negative <= 0.2 & LR_negative > 0.1 ~
        "Moderate benign-like support",
      LR_negative <= 0.1 ~
        "Strong benign-like support",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

binary_tool_performance_summary %>%
  select(
    tool,
    sensitivity,
    specificity,
    LR_positive_display,
    LR_positive_interpretation,
    LR_negative_display,
    LR_negative_interpretation
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

##final interpretation summary table
```{r create-final-tool-interpretation-summary}
final_tool_interpretation_summary <- binary_tool_performance_summary %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_percent = round(
      n_evaluated / total_eligible_binary_variants * 100,
      1
    ),
    
    coverage_category = case_when(
      coverage_percent >= 50 ~ "Moderate coverage",
      coverage_percent >= 25 ~ "Low-to-moderate coverage",
      coverage_percent < 25 ~ "Low coverage",
      TRUE ~ "Not assessed"
    ),
    
    mcc_category = case_when(
      is.na(mcc) ~ "Not interpretable",
      mcc >= 0.3 ~ "Relatively better performance",
      mcc >= 0.2 ~ "Modest performance",
      mcc >= 0 ~ "Low performance",
      mcc < 0 ~ "Poor performance",
      TRUE ~ "Not interpretable"
    ),
    
    overall_interpretation = case_when(
      is.na(mcc) ~ "Not suitable for ranking because one or more metrics could not be calculated.",
      
      coverage_percent < 25 ~
        "Interpret cautiously because coverage was low.",
      
      mcc >= 0.3 & coverage_percent >= 25 ~
        "Among the better-performing tools in this dataset, but still requires cautious interpretation.",
      
      mcc >= 0.2 & coverage_percent >= 25 ~
        "Showed modest performance in this dataset.",
      
      mcc >= 0 & coverage_percent >= 25 ~
        "Showed limited performance in this dataset.",
      
      mcc < 0 ~
        "Performed poorly in this dataset.",
      
      TRUE ~ "Interpret cautiously."
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    tool,
    total_eligible_binary_variants,
    n_evaluated,
    coverage_percent,
    coverage_category,
    accuracy,
    sensitivity,
    specificity,
    balanced_accuracy,
    mcc,
    mcc_category,
    LR_positive_display,
    LR_positive_interpretation,
    LR_negative_display,
    LR_negative_interpretation,
    overall_interpretation
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mcc))

final_tool_interpretation_summary %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## define helper functions
```{r define-binary-performance-helper-functions}
clean_numeric_score <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      stringr::str_extract(
        as.character(x),
        "-?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+")))}

classify_prediction_label <- function(x) {
  
  x_clean <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  
  case_when(
    x_clean %in% c(
      "d",
      "damaging",
      "deleterious",
      "disease_causing",
      "disease causing",
      "disease-causing",
      "pathogenic",
      "likely pathogenic",
      "likely_pathogenic",
      "probably damaging",
      "possibly damaging",
      "high",
      "medium"
    ) ~ "Pathogenic",
    
    x_clean %in% c(
      "t",
      "n",
      "b",
      "neutral",
      "tolerated",
      "benign",
      "likely benign",
      "likely_benign",
      "polymorphism",
      "low",
      "low impact",
      "neutral polymorphism"
    ) ~ "Benign",
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)}
```

```{r create-broad-variant-groups}
if ("Consequence_new" %in% names(ANALYSIS_DATASET)) {

} else if ("Effect_function" %in% names(ANALYSIS_DATASET)) {

} else {

}

ANALYSIS_DATASET <- ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
  mutate(
    variant_consequence_for_grouping = as.character(variant_consequence_for_grouping),
    
    broad_variant_group = case_when(
      grepl("missense", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Missense",
      
      grepl("frameshift", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Frameshift",
      
      grepl("stop_gained|stop lost|stop_lost|start_lost|start lost", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Stop/start altered",
      
      grepl("splice_acceptor|splice_donor|splice_region|splice", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Splice-related",
      
      grepl("synonymous", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Synonymous",
      
      grepl("intron|intergenic|upstream|downstream|regulatory|TF_binding|motif|non_coding|nc_transcript", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Non-coding/regulatory",
      
      grepl("5_prime_UTR|3_prime_UTR|UTR", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "UTR",
      
      grepl("coding_sequence|inframe_insertion|inframe_deletion|protein_altering", variant_consequence_for_grouping, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Other coding",
      
      is.na(variant_consequence_for_grouping) | variant_consequence_for_grouping == "" | variant_consequence_for_grouping == "-" ~ "Unannotated",
      
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
  count(broad_variant_group, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r rebuild-final-performance-outputs-after-supervisor-check}
# ============================================================
# FINAL REBUILD OF PERFORMANCE OUTPUTS AFTER SUPERVISOR CHECK
# ============================================================
# Purpose:
# 1. Force-rebuild key cleaned prediction columns, especially PolyPhen-2.
# 2. Recalculate whole-dataset binary performance.
# 3. Recalculate corrected missense-only performance.
# 4. Recreate the common missense subset.
# 5. Rebuild the final main comparison summary.
# 6. Save corrected final outputs.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Define helper functions needed for this rebuild
# ------------------------------------------------------------

classify_prediction_label <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  x_clean <- stringr::str_trim(x_clean)
  x_clean <- stringr::str_replace_all(x_clean, " ", "_")
  x_clean <- stringr::str_replace_all(x_clean, "-", "_")

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,

    x_clean %in% c(
      "d", "pathogenic", "likely_pathogenic",
      "probably_damaging", "possibly_damaging",
      "damaging", "deleterious",
      "h", "a", "s", "pp", "ps", "pm"
    ) ~ "Pathogenic",

    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "probably_damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "possibly_damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^deleterious") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^damaging") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)d(,|$)") ~ "Pathogenic",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)a(,|$)") ~ "Pathogenic",

    x_clean %in% c(
      "t", "b", "benign", "likely_benign",
      "tolerated", "neutral",
      "n", "l", "bm", "bp"
    ) ~ "Benign",

    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^tolerated") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^benign") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^neutral") ~ "Benign",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "(^|,)n(,|$)") ~ "Benign",

    x_clean %in% c("ambiguous", "uncertain", "unknown", "uc", "m") ~ NA_character_,

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_mutationassessor_label <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  x_clean <- stringr::str_trim(x_clean)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("h", "m", "high", "medium") ~ "Pathogenic",
    x_clean %in% c("l", "n", "low", "neutral") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_popeve_label <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  x_clean <- stringr::str_trim(x_clean)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_clean) ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean %in% c("", "-", ".", "na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    x_clean == "s" ~ "Pathogenic",
    x_clean == "b" ~ "Benign",
    x_clean == "m" ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

classify_polyphen_label_or_score <- function(polyphen_label, polyphen_score) {
  label_clean <- classify_prediction_label(polyphen_label)
  score_numeric <- as.numeric(polyphen_score)

  dplyr::case_when(
    !is.na(label_clean) ~ label_clean,
    is.na(label_clean) & !is.na(score_numeric) & score_numeric >= 0.453 ~ "Pathogenic",
    is.na(label_clean) & !is.na(score_numeric) & score_numeric < 0.453 ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

clean_numeric_score <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "-", ".", "NA", "na", "N/A", "n/a")] <- NA
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Check required helper functions exist
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("classify_prediction_label")) {
  stop("classify_prediction_label() has not been defined yet.")
}

if (!exists("classify_polyphen_label_or_score")) {
  stop("classify_polyphen_label_or_score() has not been defined yet.")
}

if (!exists("calculate_binary_tool_performance")) {
  stop("calculate_binary_tool_performance() has not been defined yet.")
}

if (!exists("BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET")) {
  stop("BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET has not been created yet.")
}

if (!exists("classify_mutationassessor_label")) {
  stop("classify_mutationassessor_label() has not been defined yet.")
}

if (!exists("classify_popeve_label")) {
  stop("classify_popeve_label() has not been defined yet.")
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Force-rebuild selected cleaned prediction columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# This overwrites old/stale versions.
# This is important for PolyPhen-2, which previously had only 18 usable
# categorical predictions before using PolyPhen_score as fallback.

BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET <- BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET %>%
  mutate(
    SIFT_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(SIFT_new),

    PolyPhen_predicted_clean = classify_polyphen_label_or_score(
      polyphen_label = PolyPhen_new,
      polyphen_score = PolyPhen_score
    ),

    PROVEAN_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(PROVEAN_pred_new),

    MutationTaster_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(
      MutationTaster_pred_new
    ),

    MutationAssessor_predicted_clean = classify_mutationassessor_label(
      MutationAssessor_pred_new
    ),

    MutPred2_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(MutPred2_pred_new),

    DEOGEN2_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(DEOGEN2_pred_new),

    PrimateAI_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(PrimateAI_pred_new),

    ClinPred_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(ClinPred_pred_new),

    MetaSVM_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(MetaSVM_pred_new),

    MetaLR_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(MetaLR_pred_new),

    MetaRNN_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(MetaRNN_pred_new),

    BayesDel_addAF_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(
      BayesDel_addAF_pred_new
    ),

    BayesDel_noAF_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(
      BayesDel_noAF_pred_new
    ),

    LIST_S2_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(LIST_S2_pred_new),

    AlphaMissense_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(am_class_new),

    EVE_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(EVE_CLASS_new),

    ESM1b_predicted_clean = classify_prediction_label(ESM1b_pred_new),

    popEVE_predicted_clean = classify_popeve_label(popEVE_pred_new),

    DANN_score_numeric = clean_numeric_score(DANN_score_new),

    DANN_predicted_clean = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(DANN_score_numeric) & DANN_score_numeric >= 0.971 ~ "Pathogenic",
      !is.na(DANN_score_numeric) & DANN_score_numeric < 0.971 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Eigen_PC_score_numeric = clean_numeric_score(Eigen_PC_phred_coding_new),

    Eigen_PC_predicted_clean = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(Eigen_PC_score_numeric) & Eigen_PC_score_numeric >= 1.3 ~ "Pathogenic",
      !is.na(Eigen_PC_score_numeric) & Eigen_PC_score_numeric < 1.3 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    CADD_score_numeric = clean_numeric_score(CADD_PHRED_new),

    CADD_predicted_clean = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(CADD_score_numeric) & CADD_score_numeric >= 10.44 ~ "Pathogenic",
      !is.na(CADD_score_numeric) & CADD_score_numeric < 10.44 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Recreate binary prediction tool map
# ------------------------------------------------------------

binary_prediction_tool_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~tool, ~prediction_column,
  "SIFT", "SIFT_predicted_clean",
  "PolyPhen-2", "PolyPhen_predicted_clean",
  "PROVEAN", "PROVEAN_predicted_clean",
  "MutationTaster", "MutationTaster_predicted_clean",
  "MutationAssessor", "MutationAssessor_predicted_clean",
  "MutPred2", "MutPred2_predicted_clean",
  "DEOGEN2", "DEOGEN2_predicted_clean",
  "PrimateAI", "PrimateAI_predicted_clean",

  "MetaSVM", "MetaSVM_predicted_clean",

  "MetaRNN", "MetaRNN_predicted_clean",
  "BayesDel addAF", "BayesDel_addAF_predicted_clean",

  "CADD", "CADD_predicted_clean",
  "DANN", "DANN_predicted_clean",
  "Eigen-PC", "Eigen_PC_predicted_clean"
)

binary_prediction_tool_map_available <- binary_prediction_tool_map %>%
  filter(
    prediction_column %in% names(BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Recalculate whole-dataset binary performance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

binary_tool_performance_summary <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  binary_prediction_tool_map_available$prediction_column,
  binary_prediction_tool_map_available$tool,
  ~ calculate_binary_tool_performance(
    data = BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET,
    observed_col = "observed_binary",
    predicted_col = .x,
    tool_name = .y
  )
) %>%
  arrange(desc(mcc))

binary_performance_summary_with_coverage <- binary_tool_performance_summary %>%
  mutate(
    percent_binary_variants_evaluated = round(
      n_evaluated / total_eligible_binary_variants * 100,
      1
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mcc))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Rebuild corrected missense-only binary dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# This rebuilds the corrected missense flag directly inside
# BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET, so it does not depend on an older
# variant_group_missense column.

MISSENSE_BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET <- BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET %>%
  mutate(
    effect_function_lower = stringr::str_to_lower(
      as.character(Effect_function)
    ),
    consequence_lower = stringr::str_to_lower(
      as.character(Consequence)
    ),
    variant_group_missense_rebuilt = !is.na(effect_function_lower) &
      !is.na(consequence_lower) &
      stringr::str_detect(effect_function_lower, "missense") &
      !stringr::str_detect(
        consequence_lower,
        "intron|utr|upstream|downstream|non_coding|regulatory|promoter"
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    observed_binary %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"),
    variant_group_missense_rebuilt == TRUE
  )

MISSENSE_BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET %>%
  summarise(
    corrected_binary_missense_variants = n(),
    pathogenic = sum(observed_binary == "Pathogenic", na.rm = TRUE),
    benign = sum(observed_binary == "Benign", na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Recalculate corrected missense-only performance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

  filter(
    prediction_column %in% names(MISSENSE_BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET)
  )

  mutate(

      n_evaluated / total_eligible_binary_variants * 100,
      1
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mcc))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Rebuild common missense subset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

  "MutPred2_predicted_clean",

  "ESM1b",
  "PolyPhen-2",
  "CADD"
)

missing_common_subset_columns <- setdiff(
  selected_common_subset_tools,

)

if (length(missing_common_subset_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Some selected common-subset prediction columns are missing: ",
    paste(missing_common_subset_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

COMMON_MISSENSE_BINARY_DATASET <- MISSENSE_BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET %>%
  filter(

    )
  )

COMMON_MISSENSE_BINARY_DATASET %>%
  count(observed_binary)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Recalculate common-subset performance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

common_missense_subset_performance <- purrr::map2_dfr(

  )
) %>%
  arrange(desc(mcc))


# ------------------------------------------------------------

whole_dataset_summary_for_comparison <- binary_performance_summary_with_coverage %>%
  select(
    tool,
```

```{r optimise-thresholds-for-confirmed-tools-whole-dataset-final}
# ============================================================
# OPTIMISE THRESHOLDS FOR CONFIRMED SCORE-BASED TOOLS
# ============================================================

optimise_single_tool_threshold <- function(
    data,
    tool_name,
    score_column,
    pathogenic_score_direction
) {
  
  optimisation_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      observed_binary %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      score_for_threshold = clean_numeric_score(.data[[score_column]])
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(score_for_threshold)
    )
  
  if (nrow(optimisation_data) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        tool = tool_name,
        score_column = score_column,
        pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction,
        optimised_threshold = NA_real_,
        n_evaluated = 0,
        accuracy = NA_real_,
        sensitivity = NA_real_,
        specificity = NA_real_,
        balanced_accuracy = NA_real_,
        mcc = NA_real_))}
  
  candidate_thresholds <- sort(unique(optimisation_data$score_for_threshold))
  
  threshold_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
    candidate_thresholds,
    function(current_threshold) {
      
      threshold_data <- optimisation_data %>%
        mutate(
          optimised_prediction = dplyr::case_when(
            pathogenic_score_direction == "higher" &
              score_for_threshold >= current_threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
            
            pathogenic_score_direction == "higher" &
              score_for_threshold < current_threshold ~ "Benign",
            
            pathogenic_score_direction == "lower" &
              score_for_threshold <= current_threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
            
            pathogenic_score_direction == "lower" &
              score_for_threshold > current_threshold ~ "Benign",
            
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          )
        )
      
      performance <- calculate_binary_tool_performance(
        data = threshold_data,
        observed_col = "observed_binary",
        predicted_col = "optimised_prediction",
        tool_name = tool_name
      )
      
      performance %>%
        mutate(
          optimised_threshold = current_threshold,
          score_column = score_column,
          pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction
        )
    }
  )
  
  threshold_results %>%
    arrange(
      desc(mcc),
      desc(balanced_accuracy),
      desc(accuracy)
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    select(
      tool,
      score_column,
      pathogenic_score_direction,
      optimised_threshold,
      n_evaluated,
      accuracy,
      sensitivity,
      specificity,
      balanced_accuracy,
      mcc
    )
}

optimised_thresholds_confirmed_tools_whole_dataset <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  confirmed_threshold_optimisation_candidates %>%
    filter(
      score_column %in% names(BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET),
      pathogenic_score_direction %in% c("higher", "lower")
    ) %>%
    select(
      tool,
      score_column,
      pathogenic_score_direction
    ),
  ~ optimise_single_tool_threshold(
    data = BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET,
    tool_name = ..1,
    score_column = ..2,
    pathogenic_score_direction = ..3
  )
) %>%
```

```{r same-variant-default-vs-optimised-score-threshold-comparison-final}
# ============================================================
# FINAL SAME-SCORE DEFAULT VS OPTIMISED THRESHOLD COMPARISON
# ============================================================
# This applies both the default threshold and the optimised threshold
# directly to the same score column, on the same score-available variants.
# ============================================================

safe_divide <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  ifelse(denominator == 0, NA_real_, numerator / denominator)
}

calculate_direct_prediction_performance <- function(data, observed_col, predicted_col, tool_name) {
  
  performance_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[observed_col]]),
      !is.na(.data[[predicted_col]])
    )
  
  TP <- as.numeric(sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Pathogenic" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Pathogenic",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))
  
  TN <- as.numeric(sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Benign" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Benign",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))
  
  FP <- as.numeric(sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Benign" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Pathogenic",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))
  
  FN <- as.numeric(sum(
    performance_data[[observed_col]] == "Pathogenic" &
      performance_data[[predicted_col]] == "Benign",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))
  
  n_evaluated <- TP + TN + FP + FN
  
  sensitivity <- safe_divide(TP, TP + FN)
  specificity <- safe_divide(TN, TN + FP)
  
  mcc_denominator <- sqrt(
    (TP + FP) *
      (TP + FN) *
      (TN + FP) *
      (TN + FN)
  )
  
  mcc <- safe_divide(
    (TP * TN) - (FP * FN),
    mcc_denominator
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    tool = tool_name,
    n_evaluated = n_evaluated,
    true_positive = TP,
    true_negative = TN,
    false_positive = FP,
    false_negative = FN,
    accuracy = round(safe_divide(TP + TN, n_evaluated), 3),
    sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
    specificity = round(specificity, 3),
    balanced_accuracy = round(mean(c(sensitivity, specificity), na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mcc = round(mcc, 3)
  )
}

classify_score_with_threshold <- function(score, threshold, pathogenic_score_direction) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(score) ~ NA_character_,
    is.na(threshold) ~ NA_character_,
    is.na(pathogenic_score_direction) ~ NA_character_,
    
    pathogenic_score_direction == "higher" & score >= threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
    pathogenic_score_direction == "higher" & score < threshold ~ "Benign",
    
    pathogenic_score_direction == "lower" & score <= threshold ~ "Pathogenic",
    pathogenic_score_direction == "lower" & score > threshold ~ "Benign",
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

default_score_threshold_reference_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~tool, ~default_threshold,
  
  "SIFT", 0.05,

)

# Force correct score columns and optimised thresholds for CADD and PolyPhen-2
optimised_thresholds_for_same_score <- optimised_thresholds_confirmed_tools_whole_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    score_column = dplyr::case_when(
      tool == "CADD" ~ "CADD_PHRED_new",
      tool == "PolyPhen-2" ~ "PolyPhen_score",
      TRUE ~ score_column
    ),
    optimised_threshold = dplyr::case_when(
      tool == "CADD" ~ 10.6,
      tool == "PolyPhen-2" ~ 0.098,
      TRUE ~ optimised_threshold
    )
  )

same_score_threshold_input_final <- optimised_thresholds_for_same_score %>%
  select(
    tool,
    score_column,
    pathogenic_score_direction,
    optimised_threshold
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    default_score_threshold_reference_table,
    by = "tool"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    score_column %in% names(BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET),
    pathogenic_score_direction %in% c("higher", "lower"),
    !is.na(default_threshold),
    !is.na(optimised_threshold)
  )

compare_default_vs_optimised_score_thresholds_final <- function(
    data,
    tool_name,
    score_column,
    pathogenic_score_direction,
    default_threshold,
    optimised_threshold
) {
  
  comparison_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      observed_binary %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      score_for_threshold = clean_numeric_score(.data[[score_column]]),
      
      default_score_threshold_prediction = classify_score_with_threshold(
        score = score_for_threshold,
        threshold = default_threshold,
        pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction
      ),
      
      optimised_score_threshold_prediction = classify_score_with_threshold(
        score = score_for_threshold,
        threshold = optimised_threshold,
        pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(score_for_threshold),
      !is.na(default_score_threshold_prediction),
      !is.na(optimised_score_threshold_prediction)
    )
  
  default_performance <- calculate_direct_prediction_performance(
    data = comparison_data,
    observed_col = "observed_binary",
    predicted_col = "default_score_threshold_prediction",
    tool_name = tool_name
  )
  
  optimised_performance <- calculate_direct_prediction_performance(
    data = comparison_data,
    observed_col = "observed_binary",
    predicted_col = "optimised_score_threshold_prediction",
    tool_name = tool_name
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    tool = tool_name,
    score_column = score_column,
    pathogenic_score_direction = pathogenic_score_direction,
    same_score_available_n = nrow(comparison_data),
    
    default_threshold = default_threshold,
    optimised_threshold = optimised_threshold,
    
    default_accuracy_same_score_subset = default_performance$accuracy,
    default_sensitivity_same_score_subset = default_performance$sensitivity,
    default_specificity_same_score_subset = default_performance$specificity,
    default_balanced_accuracy_same_score_subset = default_performance$balanced_accuracy,
    default_mcc_same_score_subset = default_performance$mcc,
    
    optimised_accuracy_same_score_subset = optimised_performance$accuracy,
    optimised_sensitivity_same_score_subset = optimised_performance$sensitivity,
    optimised_specificity_same_score_subset = optimised_performance$specificity,
    optimised_balanced_accuracy_same_score_subset = optimised_performance$balanced_accuracy,
    optimised_mcc_same_score_subset = optimised_performance$mcc,
    
    mcc_change_same_score_subset = round(
      optimised_performance$mcc - default_performance$mcc,
      3
    )
  )
}

default_vs_optimised_same_score_threshold_comparison <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  same_score_threshold_input_final,
  ~ compare_default_vs_optimised_score_thresholds_final(
    data = BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET,
    tool_name = ..1,
    score_column = ..2,
    pathogenic_score_direction = ..3,
    optimised_threshold = ..4,
    default_threshold = ..5
  )
) %>%
  arrange(desc(mcc_change_same_score_subset))

default_vs_optimised_same_score_threshold_comparison %>%
  select(
    tool,
    same_score_available_n,
    default_threshold,
    optimised_threshold,
    default_mcc_same_score_subset,
    optimised_mcc_same_score_subset,
    mcc_change_same_score_subset
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

readr::write_csv(
  default_vs_optimised_same_score_threshold_comparison,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "default_vs_optimised_same_score_threshold_comparison.csv"
  )
)
```

## createing allele frequency analysis dataset
```{r create-allele-frequency-analysis-dataset}
# ============================================================
# CREATE ALLELE-FREQUENCY ANALYSIS DATASET
# ============================================================
# Main AF column: gnomAD4.1 joint POPMAX AF
# Additional AF columns are kept for comparison.
# ============================================================

clean_af_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "-", ".", "NA", "na", "N/A", "n/a", "invalid_field")] <- NA
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

AF_ANALYSIS_DATASET <- ANALYSIS_DATASET_WITH_VARIANT_GROUPS %>%
  mutate(
    clinical_group = dplyr::case_when(
      Observed_pathogenicity %in% c("P", "LP", "P/LP", "Pathogenic", "Likely pathogenic") ~ "P/LP",
      Observed_pathogenicity %in% c("B", "LB", "B/LB", "Benign", "Likely benign") ~ "B/LB",
      Observed_pathogenicity %in% c("VUS", "Uncertain significance", "Uncertain") ~ "VUS",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Observed_pathogenicity)
    ),

    af_gnomad4_joint = clean_af_value(gnomAD4_1_joint_AF_new),
    af_gnomad4_popmax = clean_af_value(gnomAD4_1_joint_POPMAX_AF_new),
    af_gnomad4_afr = clean_af_value(gnomAD4_1_joint_AFR_AF_new),
    af_dbnsfp_popmax = clean_af_value(dbNSFP_POPMAX_AF_new)
  )

AF_ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
  count(clinical_group) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

AF_ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
  summarise(
    total_variants = n(),
    gnomad4_joint_available = sum(!is.na(af_gnomad4_joint)),
    gnomad4_popmax_available = sum(!is.na(af_gnomad4_popmax)),
    gnomad4_afr_available = sum(!is.na(af_gnomad4_afr)),
    dbnsfp_popmax_available = sum(!is.na(af_dbnsfp_popmax))
  )
```

```{r summarise-af-by-clinical-group}

  ) %>%

    n_with_popmax_af = sum(!is.na(af_gnomad4_popmax)),

    min_popmax_af = min(af_gnomad4_popmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_popmax_af = max(af_gnomad4_popmax, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_af_zero = sum(af_gnomad4_popmax == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_af_above_0_001 = sum(af_gnomad4_popmax > 0.001, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_af_above_0_01 = sum(af_gnomad4_popmax > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),

    percent_af_above_0_001 = round(
      n_af_above_0_001 / n_with_popmax_af * 100,
      1
    ),
    percent_af_above_0_01 = round(
      n_af_above_0_01 / n_with_popmax_af * 100,
```

```{r create-tool-error-groups-for-af-analysis}
# ============================================================
# CREATE TOOL ERROR GROUPS FOR AF ANALYSIS
# ============================================================
# Compares AF distributions across TP, TN, FP and FN.
# Uses MutPred2, AlphaMissense and CADD if their prediction columns exist.
# ============================================================

create_tool_error_group <- function(data, tool_name, prediction_column) {
  
  if (!prediction_column %in% names(data)) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", tool_name, "- missing column:", prediction_column))
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }
  
  data %>%
    filter(
      observed_binary %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"),
      !is.na(.data[[prediction_column]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      tool = tool_name,
      tool_prediction = .data[[prediction_column]],
      tool_error_group = dplyr::case_when(
        observed_binary == "Pathogenic" & tool_prediction == "Pathogenic" ~ "TP",
        observed_binary == "Benign" & tool_prediction == "Benign" ~ "TN",
        observed_binary == "Benign" & tool_prediction == "Pathogenic" ~ "FP",
        observed_binary == "Pathogenic" & tool_prediction == "Benign" ~ "FN",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

AF_TOOL_ERROR_DATASET <- bind_rows(
  create_tool_error_group(
    data = BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET,
    tool_name = "MutPred2",
    prediction_column = "MutPred2_predicted_clean"
  ),
  create_tool_error_group(
    data = BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET,
    tool_name = "AlphaMissense",
    prediction_column = "AlphaMissense_predicted_clean"
  ),
  create_tool_error_group(
    data = BINARY_PERFORMANCE_DATASET,
    tool_name = "CADD",
    prediction_column = "CADD_predicted_clean"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    af_gnomad4_popmax = clean_af_value(gnomAD4_1_joint_POPMAX_AF_new),
    af_gnomad4_joint = clean_af_value(gnomAD4_1_joint_AF_new),
    af_gnomad4_afr = clean_af_value(gnomAD4_1_joint_AFR_AF_new)
  )

AF_TOOL_ERROR_DATASET %>%
  count(tool, tool_error_group) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

##Define group-specific coverage function using the same logic as the original coverage table, but calculates coverage inside each variant group.

```{r define-binary-tool-coverage-by-group-function}
count_binary_tool_coverage_by_group <- function(data, tool_name, columns, group_col) {
  
  existing_columns <- columns[columns %in% names(data)]
  
  if (length(existing_columns) == 0) {
    return(
      data %>%
        group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
        summarise(
          total_variants_in_group = if ("original_row_id" %in% names(data)) {
            dplyr::n_distinct(original_row_id)
          } else {
            n()
          },
          variants_with_tool_output = 0,
          variants_without_tool_output = total_variants_in_group,
          percent_with_tool_output = 0,
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        rename(variant_group = .data[[group_col]]) %>%
        mutate(
          tool = tool_name,
          columns_present = NA_character_
        ) %>%
        select(
          tool,
          variant_group,
          total_variants_in_group,
          variants_with_tool_output,
          variants_without_tool_output,
          percent_with_tool_output,
          columns_present
        )
    )
  }
  
  usable_matrix <- sapply(
    existing_columns,
    function(col) {
      is_usable_tool_value(data[[col]])
    }
  )
  
  if (is.vector(usable_matrix)) {
    usable_any <- usable_matrix
  } else {
    usable_any <- rowSums(usable_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }
  
  data_with_usable_flag <- data %>%
    mutate(tool_has_output = usable_any)
  
  data_with_usable_flag %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      total_variants_in_group = if ("original_row_id" %in% names(data_with_usable_flag)) {
        dplyr::n_distinct(original_row_id)
      } else {
        n()
      },
      variants_with_tool_output = if ("original_row_id" %in% names(data_with_usable_flag)) {
        dplyr::n_distinct(original_row_id[tool_has_output])
      } else {
        sum(tool_has_output)
      },
      variants_without_tool_output = total_variants_in_group - variants_with_tool_output,
      percent_with_tool_output = round(
        variants_with_tool_output / total_variants_in_group * 100,
        1
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(variant_group = .data[[group_col]]) %>%
    mutate(
      tool = tool_name,
      columns_present = paste(existing_columns, collapse = "; ")
    ) %>%
    select(
      tool,
      variant_group,
      total_variants_in_group,
      variants_with_tool_output,
      variants_without_tool_output,
      percent_with_tool_output,
      columns_present
    )
}
```

```{r define-usable-tool-value-function}
is_usable_tool_value <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- trimws(as.character(x))
  
  !is.na(x) &
    x_clean != "" &
    x_clean != "-" &
    x_clean != "." &
    !(tolower(x_clean) %in% c(
      "na",
      "nan",
      "null",
      "not_available",
      "not available"
    ))
}
```

```{r define-count-tool-coverage-by-group-function}
count_tool_coverage_by_group <- function(data, tool_name, columns, group_col) {
  
  columns_present <- columns[columns %in% names(data)]
  
  if (length(columns_present) == 0) {
    return(
      data %>%
        group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
        summarise(
          tool = tool_name,
          total_variants_in_group = n(),
          variants_with_tool_output = 0,
          variants_without_tool_output = n(),
          percent_with_tool_output = 0,
          columns_present = "None",
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        rename(variant_group = .data[[group_col]])
    )
  }
  
  data %>%
    mutate(
      has_tool_output = if_any(
        all_of(columns_present),
        is_usable_tool_value
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      tool = tool_name,
      total_variants_in_group = n(),
      variants_with_tool_output = sum(has_tool_output, na.rm = TRUE),
      variants_without_tool_output = total_variants_in_group - variants_with_tool_output,
      percent_with_tool_output = round(
        variants_with_tool_output / total_variants_in_group * 100,
        1
      ),
      columns_present = paste(columns_present, collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(variant_group = .data[[group_col]])
}
```

##this is to extract the numeric characters to allow the thresholds be applicable
```{r helper-clean-numeric-scores}
clean_numeric_score <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      str_extract(
        as.character(x),
        "-?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+" )))}
```

## convert available numeric scores into binary prediction

```{r create-tool-predicted-classes}
ANALYSIS_DATASET <- ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
  mutate(
    PROVEAN_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(PROVEAN_score_new),
    FATHMM_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(FATHMM_score_seperated),
    FATHMM_MKL_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(`fathmm-MKL_coding_score`),
    REVEL_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(REVEL_score_new),
    ClinPred_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(ClinPred_score_new),
    MetaSVM_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(MetaSVM_score_new),
    MetaLR_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(MetaLR_score_new),
    BayesDel_addAF_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(BayesDel_addAF_score_new),
    BayesDel_noAF_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(BayesDel_noAF_score_new),
    LIST_S2_new_numeric = clean_numeric_score(LIST_S2_score_new),

    PROVEAN_predicted = case_when(
      PROVEAN_new_numeric <= -2.5 ~ "Pathogenic",
      PROVEAN_new_numeric > -2.5 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    FATHMM_predicted = case_when(
      FATHMM_new_numeric <= -1.5 ~ "Pathogenic",
      FATHMM_new_numeric > -1.5 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    FATHMM_MKL_predicted = case_when(
      FATHMM_MKL_new_numeric > 0.5 ~ "Pathogenic",
      FATHMM_MKL_new_numeric < 0.5 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    REVEL_predicted = case_when(
      REVEL_new_numeric > 0.5 ~ "Pathogenic",
      REVEL_new_numeric <= 0.5 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    ClinPred_predicted = case_when(
      ClinPred_new_numeric > 0.5 ~ "Pathogenic",
      ClinPred_new_numeric <= 0.5 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    MetaSVM_predicted = case_when(
      MetaSVM_new_numeric > 0 ~ "Pathogenic",
      MetaSVM_new_numeric <= 0 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    MetaLR_predicted = case_when(
      MetaLR_new_numeric > 0.5 ~ "Pathogenic",
      MetaLR_new_numeric <= 0.5 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    BayesDel_addAF_predicted = case_when(
      BayesDel_addAF_new_numeric > 0.0692655 ~ "Pathogenic",
      BayesDel_addAF_new_numeric <= 0.0692655 ~ "Benign",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    BayesDel_noAF_predicted = case_when(

      BayesDel_noAF_new_numeric <= -0.0570105 ~ "Benign",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r create-main-tool-predicted-columns}
ANALYSIS_DATASET <- ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
```

    AlphaMissense_predicted = case_when(
      am_class_new == "likely_benign" ~ "Benign",
      am_class_new == "likely_pathogenic" ~ "Pathogenic",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

ANALYSIS_DATASET %>%
  count(am_class_new, AlphaMissense_predicted)

```{r best-tool-by-performance-metric}
best_metric_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Highest accuracy",
    "Highest sensitivity",
    "Highest specificity",
    "Highest balanced accuracy",
    "Highest MCC"
  ),
  
  tool = c(

      which.max(binary_tool_performance_summary$accuracy)
    ],
    binary_tool_performance_summary$tool[
      which.max(binary_tool_performance_summary$sensitivity)
    ],
    binary_tool_performance_summary$tool[
      which.max(binary_tool_performance_summary$specificity)
    ],
    binary_tool_performance_summary$tool[
      which.max(binary_tool_performance_summary$balanced_accuracy)
    ],
    binary_tool_performance_summary$tool[
      which.max(binary_tool_performance_summary$mcc)
    ]
  ),
  
  value = c(
    max(binary_tool_performance_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(binary_tool_performance_summary$sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(binary_tool_performance_summary$specificity, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(binary_tool_performance_summary$balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(binary_tool_performance_summary$mcc, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
```
